articleTitle: Unveiling Covert Databases: A Comprehensive Detection Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Data protection is more critical in the digitized world today. In addition to these secure databases, the concept of cybersecurity protocols also brings into play the concept of hidden databases. These databases mask themselves under innocuous-sounding names in digital space and bring their peculiar set of challenges. The paper, therefore, examines the concept of databases through creation processes, motives, and the nature of risks they introduce. This paper will illustrate the application of data analytics, machine learning, and anomaly detection techniques to demonstrate how such systems can be revealed. Our approach classifies hidden databases by their intended use to effectively strengthen cybersecurity defenses. Here the ultimate aim is to unmask these well-concealed threats and help businesses protect information, thereby enhancing security in the domain.

articleTitle: AI4BCancer: Breast Cancer Classification using AutoML - TPOT with PCA
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Breast cancer is the most common cancer diagnosed in women and is a significant cause of cancer-related deaths among women worldwide. It demands accurate and timely detection methods for improved patient outcomes. This study proposes a novel machine learning approach to enhance breast cancer classification. Emphasizing the urgency of early diagnosis, we compare existing models and find AutoML - TPOT with PCA achieving the highest accuracy among all models tested. This proposed model integrates advanced algorithms and PCA to improve accuracy and computational efficiency. Through rigorous evaluation on the Wisconsin Breast Cancer Dataset, this model demonstrates superior performance, achieving an accuracy of 98.6%. This highlights its potential to significantly impact breast cancer diagnosis and treatment planning, contributing to ongoing efforts to improve patient care. Future work will focus on integrating Explainable AI to enhance model transparency and clinical trust.

articleTitle: The Role of Artificial Intelligence in the Management of Long-term Care and Prevention
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Managing common chronic conditions puts enormous pressure on healthcare systems. This is why it is timely that, in the case of chronic diseases, AIl encourages preventive measures and long-duration control, which is likely to bring new trends to the treatment vector. This review summarises the current state of artificial intelligence in chronic disease management, including spearheads, control therapy, individualized treatment, and patient engagement. We outline pathways for future AI use and development in that area and detail the advantages and disadvantages of AI implementation. Controlling chronic diseases is also a rehabilitation strategy to help recover the patient’s health and eliminate comorbidities. The management of chronic conditions in health care has improved remarkably due to AI, clinical decision support systems, remote patient monitoring, predictive analytics, and patient participation through personalized medication. Chronic illnesses, despite being a global concern, are burdensome to healthcare. Hence, as chronic diseases by nature require more focus on prevention and prolonged treatment, AI stands to greatly impact the management of these diseases. This paper presents evidence of how the management of chronic disease, in its various forms, is being aided by the use of artificial intelligence today. We talk about the benefits and challenges of implementing AI and present a vision for the further use and development of AI in management.

articleTitle: AI in Education: A Neutrosophic Graph Framework for Evaluating Challenges and Opportunities
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The framework proposed in this paper evaluates key strengths, such as AI's ability to enhance personalized learning and automation of administrative tasks, while addressing significant weaknesses, including ethical concerns, privacy issues, and inequitable access to AI technologies. Opportunities created by AI, such as the potential for global accessibility to education, the development of innovative pedagogical models, and the creation of intelligent tutoring systems, are balanced against threats like the displacement of educational jobs, biases in algorithmic outcomes, and the risk of widening socioeconomic disparities. The use of SVNGs allows the study to establish causal relationships between various SWOT components, with the indeterminacy of connections between these factors represented graphically through neutrosophic graphs. Energy analysis is employed to assess the impact of AI in each quadrant—Strength-Opportunities (SO), Strength-Threats (ST), Weakness-Opportunities (WO), and Weakness-Threats (WT). By calculating the energy of each quadrant, the study quantifies the potential benefits and risks of AI integration into educational frameworks. The findings suggest that while the opportunities presented by AI outweigh some of its associated threats, a careful and strategic approach is required to ensure that its implementation is ethical, equitable, and effective.

articleTitle: Lean Model for Improving Educational Institute grade and Student Performances
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Lean thinking already proved to be the most efficient process for improvement in the production and service industry. Educational Institute is also getting benefitted by the lean model and improved their processes for better prospects for the students. This study focus on lean principles for educational institute to transform their process, eliminate waste and improve the productivity. This study also find out the gaps in achieving the target goal and implement lean tools to satisfy the student need to meet the target.

articleTitle: Profiling of Learners and Instructors for Developing an Intelligent Learning Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The world of education is more dynamic and varied than it has ever been. Students coming from various backgrounds have diverse interests, abilities, and challenges. Instructors also have distinct goals, techniques, and teaching approaches. Understanding the needs of learners and educators is essential to ensuring that learning is beneficial for everyone. This survey-based analysis aids in understanding the demands of instructors and pupils. We can gain important insights by interviewing teachers and students about their expectations, preferences, and experiences. These findings aid in the creation of more intelligent learning environments. For instance, teaching strategies can be modified to overcome difficulties in a certain topic, for a large number of the students. In a similar vein, we can integrate preferred tools and resources into our platforms to facilitate and improve education. The goal of this study is to understand factors affecting learning environments that are conducive to offering a better learning environment.

articleTitle: ImageCraft - Text To Image Synthesis
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: In computer vision and natural language processing, text-to-image creation creates an image from a textual description. Text-to-picture generation aims to produce an image that visually appeals to the eye and captures the essence of a textual description. Generative adversarial networks (GANs), variational autoencoders (VAEs), and reinforcement learning are some of the methods used in text-to-image generation. Every strategy has pros and cons, and the best course of action relies on the particular demands of the work at hand. The objective of this project is to set up an experimental workbench on Amazon Sage Maker where the Deep Learning model is trained to generate synthetic images from a text prompt by the user, the model tested shows a significant increase in the quality of images when compared to a model using reduced vocabulary size for the input text embedding vector.

articleTitle: The role of AI in understanding consumer buying motive in the farm implementation
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: "Unity in diversity" is beautiful feature for India, It has different cultures, language, customs, tradition, habits, at the same time India also go for development in Infrastructures, information technology, agriculture, etc. India is second largest Population country in the world, But India also suffer for many problem one of major problems about famers market accessibility & agricultural profitability.The agricultural sector can plays a pivotal role in sustaining security for food and economic development. Understanding the complex subtleties of agricultural purchasing decisions and motivations is essential for fostering sustainable agricultural practices and facilitating the growth of agribusinesses. This research aims to develop Artificial intelligence (AI) framework into the influencing agricultural choices when it comes to procuring farms impute, equipment, and services.

articleTitle: Recommendation of Marketplace using Filter-based Model for Farmers
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Agriculture and related industries are vital for rural employment and income, contributing significantly to the country's economy. However, agricultural productivity in India lags behind other countries, especially in terms of yield per unit of land. This low productivity, coupled with financial challenges, has led to a concerning trend of farmer suicides, particularly among small-scale farmers. Increasing agricultural revenue and production requires action for dealing with these problems. This paper proposes a recommendation system for farmers to choose the best marketplace for their crops, based on analyzing historical data from various Agricultural Produce Market Committee (APMC) datasets. The recommendation model of content-based and collaborative filtering techniques and is trained on data from APMCs in Amravati District, Maharashtra, India. The model demonstrates improved performance, achieving higher recall rates at both top-5 and top-10 recommendations.

articleTitle: Application Of AI In Agricultural Mechanization Behaviour In Vidarbha (Wardha) Region
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: At the holy place of Mahatma Gandhi & Vinobha Bhave agriculture acts as a back bone of society. Farmers of vibharbha specially depend on agriculture for their livelihood needs, Modern agricultural practice and Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools improve somewhat purchasing decision and preference toward agricultural mechanization. Some application and technology may result in more conversant for purchasing decisions regarding agricultural implementations, leading to increased efficiency, improved yields, and cost savings eventually beneficial for Indian farmer wellbeing.

articleTitle: Reducing False Alarm Situation in LPG Leak Detection Using Arduino-Based Multi-Sensor (MQ-2, MQ-5, and MQ-6 Gas Sensor) Module
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: LPG is an alternative fuel used for daily use. Due to its low cost and ease of installation. This article covers an Arduino-based gas detection system that uses an Arduino UNO R3 board and gas sensors like MQ-2, MQ-5, and MQ-6, making it possible to monitor gases present in LPG. Specifically, the MQ-5 sensor detects LPG, methane, and smoke. These sensors send data to an Arduino Uno R3 microcontroller and utilize it to determine the gas concentration and trigger security precautions. When the concentration exceeds a threshold, then it gives an alarm to the user. This device also has an optional LCD screen for feedback in real time and an implicit buzzer. It showed during tests that the leaks were detected by sensors, and the alarms were working effectively as necessary. Upcoming enhancements include attachment of additional sensors, wireless connection for remote observation, and cloud-based data storage.

articleTitle: Natural Language Processing in Education System
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Natural Language Processing (NLP) leverages linguistics and computer technology to create intelligent systems, and its use in education has grown due to the abundance of educational content. NLP addresses challenges faced by educators and students, particularly in generating relevant, context-based word problems that enhance online learning. The proposed method focuses on generating legitimate mathematical word problems while tracking the relationship between problem validity and generation time. Additionally, an NLP-powered Intelligent Tutoring System (ITS) is explored with a pilot prototype chatbot designed to help students grasp programming concepts in elementary and secondary education. Test results demonstrated the potential of a cloud-based system for improving student learning. The paper also examines integrating NLP resources in Irish primary education, particularly two NLP engines used in Computer-Assisted Language Learning (CALL) for Irish language instruction. The goal is to improve learning outcomes by incorporating NLP tools into instructional materials and receiving positive feedback from students and teachers.

articleTitle: Application of Data Analytics in Healthcare Management: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The use of data analytics is causing a significant revolution in the healthcare sector. This thorough analysis explores the many applications of data analytics in healthcare administration and highlights how they may completely transform the industry. There has never been a greater demand for more effective and efficient management techniques due to the rising complexity and expenses of healthcare. Utilizing the amount of digital healthcare data and electronic health records to enhance patient care, optimize resource use, and make evidence-based decisions is a barrier that has to be overcome. The main uses of data analytics in healthcare administration are examined in this overview, covering population health management, clinical decision support, predictive analytics, operational effectiveness, fraud detection, patient engagement, medication development, and public health. In addition, it looks at the moral dilemmas and other related issues while providing predictions for new advancements and trends in this ever-changing industry. In conclusion, this research shows how improving patient outcomes, simplifying processes, and allocating resources more efficiently are all possible thanks to data analytics in healthcare administration. This study advances our understanding of the revolutionary effects of data analytics on the healthcare sector by offering a thorough overview of its uses.

articleTitle: Smart Solutions for Visual Impairment by AI-Based Assistive Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: This paper offers a systematic review on assistive technologies developed for individuals with visual impairments. The review explores a variety of approaches, including wearable devices, computer vision, deep learning, and edge computing, to enhance accessibility and independence for visually impaired users. Each study's methodologies, findings, and limitations are thoroughly examined to provide a comprehensive overview of the latest advancements in this field. The analysis underscores how wearable devices are becoming increasingly advanced, integrating sensors and AI to deliver real-time assistance. Computer vision techniques are being utilized to interpret visual information, which is then conveyed to the user through auditory or haptic feedback. The integration of deep learning and edge computing is also discussed, focusing on how these technologies enhance the accuracy and speed of assistive tools, enabling more responsive and efficient systems. However, the review also identifies several challenges, such as the need for more robust algorithms that can operate in diverse and unpredictable environments, as well as the importance of user-centered design to ensure these technologies are accessible and practical for daily use. The paper concludes by outlining potential areas for future research, emphasizing the need for interdisciplinary collaboration to further refine and expand these technologies. By synthesizing the findings from multiple studies, this review provides valuable insights for researchers and developers working to advance assistive technologies for the visually impaired.

articleTitle: 5G-Enabled Communication for Real-Time Patient Monitoring: Opportunities and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Digitally governed hospitals are the epitome of healthcare transformation, utilizing state-of-the-art technologies to revolutionize patient care and facility management. This research paper discusses the urgent requirement for the efficient deployment of 5G technology in Digitally governed hospitals, with the goal of improving connectivity, enhancing patient aftermath, and increasing operational efficiency. The paper emphasizes the importance of 5G technology in facilitating instantaneous data analysis, remote monitoring, and telemedicine, thereby transforming healthcare provision. 5G enables fast and responsive connectivity, reducing delays, and allowing healthcare providers to communicate and work together effortlessly. This leads to improved efficiency in diagnosing, treating, and caring for patients.

articleTitle: Defence System with HC 12 Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: This paper outlines for the introduction of an improved Defense system with HC-12 communication designed to better safeguard the sensitive sectors. It's able to do that through integrating a technology offshoot which is the use of an Arduino Nano controller, ultrasonic sensors, and a 360-degree robot rotator. The sensors are tuned with a ultrasonic sound, that allow minute detection and presence of any threats within given distances. The identification of this system results in the instantiation of a countermeasure which is responsible for a speedy response. The design consists of power efficient operation, note specifically by the power management, and uninterrupted move via an exact motor option control. To guarantee the usability interface is displayed in LCD monitor of the machine. Real-time information is also shown on LCD display of the machine. Furthermore, the place of security functionally serves as a defense system from unauthorized access. This newly designed defense mechanism with fine component integration and exhaustive evaluation demonstrates remarkable importance for a dramatic shift in security infrastructure, which requires constant upgrading as advanced threats emerge.

articleTitle: Dual PPG-Based Blood Flow Abnormality Detection Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: This paper presents a novel system for predicting nonuniform blood flow using dual Photoplethysmography (PPG) signals and deep learning. The hardware comprises two PPG sensors strategically placed on the finger and thumb muscle, connected to an ESP32 node MCU board for data acquisition. The captured signals are transmitted via Wi-Fi to a computer for analysis. A Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) classifier processes the dual PPG data to categorize blood flow as normal or abnormal, providing a confidence level for each prediction. The model, trained on a dataset of 960 samples from 22 individuals, achieved an accuracy of 87.3% in distinguishing between normal and abnormal blood flow patterns. Additional performance metrics, including precision (84.8%), recall (90.3%), and F1-score (87.5%), demonstrate the system's effectiveness. This approach offers a promising non-invasive method for early detection of blood flow abnormalities, potentially improving cardiovascular health monitoring.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Detection and Classification of Gastrointestinal Tract Diseases in Endoscopy Images
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: In the field of modern medicine, the detection and classification of gastrointestinal (GI) tract diseases from endoscopy images is a critical task since it helps in early intervention and improves patient outcomes. This study presents a unique way to deal with this topic, building on deep learning and using EfficientNetB1 and B0 architectures on the well-known Kvasir V2 dataset. The test performance of the EfficientNetB1 model is extremely satisfying, as it achieves an amazing accuracy of 94.75%, almost equal to the test accuracy of the EfficientNetB0 model, which is 94.31%. Although the accuracy of classification greatly varies from disease to disease, it demonstrates the complexity of GI tract conditions. Nevertheless, many finer distinctions were difficult to establish, such as stained-elevated polyps, dyed-resection margins, and esophagitis, besides typical variations including the normal appendix, normal pylorus, and normal z-line. These challenges necessitate the sophistication and expansion of our models by increasing the dataset to cover more pathological and normal cases. Yet, this study reveals the capability of deep learning to help physicians by providing them with advanced decision support devices for quick and precise GI disease diagnosis through endoscopy images. This study widens the horizons of ML-based diagnostic systems in gastroenterology, aiming at better therapy and prognosis for patients.

articleTitle: Insights into Employer Attractiveness through Text Analytics: Evidence from the Financial Technology Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Text analytics refers to deriving meaningful information from textual data. Text analytics involves using multiple techniques and tools to extract meaningful insights from various data sources like text documents, emails, online or offline feedback, conversations, or posts on various social media platforms. This study investigates the role of text analytics in understanding and enhancing employer attractiveness. Employer attractiveness can be understood or referred to as an employer’s ability to attract, engage, and retain talented employees. Reviews or feedback of employees from a prominent job portal are analyzed. Techniques like text preprocessing, sentiment analysis, topic modeling, word frequency analysis, and word cloud visualization are used to explore and understand employer attractiveness. Positive reviews and comments suggest that an organization’s culture, professional growth opportunities, and job satisfaction are the most important parameters for employees. Excessive workload, management practices, and work-life balance are major concerns of employees, which can be understood from the analysis of negative remarks. While this study is specific to the Fintech (Financial Technology) industry, it lays the groundwork for future research across various other sectors and countries.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Assisted model for Medical Image Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Accurate prognosis is serious to early detection and successful conduct of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). A deep Q-learning feature representation model that is efficient in order to predict NSCLC is presented in this study. Proposed novel method add adaptive thresholding with many feature extraction methods. By removing distinctive features from the input data, these techniques enable a more complete and accurate depiction of NSCLC characteristics. Usually, these models are not able to increase their classification accuracy with time. To solve these challenges, we offer a 1D convolutional neural network (CNN) with Q-learning, a reinforcement learning method that agrees for continual accuracy increases. The internal algorithms of our proposed model stand out for their reliability and efficiency. Adaptive thresholding allows for precise segmentation of non-small cells by dynamically varying the threshold based on localised pixel intensity. The feature extraction algorithms capture the different spatial and frequency properties found in NSCLC pictures. As a result, the process of feature representation is rich and educational. Furthermore, the model is able to continuously adapt and enhance its classification accuracy thanks to the 1D CNN with Q-learning. A 99.5% effective precision is shown by the experimental results.

articleTitle: Android based Food Rescue System
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Food wastage is serious issue in our society from many decades and it affects both poor and rich countries. Similarly, food waste has a strong impact on the environment which mainly includes greenhouse gas emission. To resolve this problem, some existing solutions are available but these systems are unable to cater the wastage of foods which is consider to be the extra food available at donor side with minimum or maximum quantity. Due to lack of time and existing available facility, food-donor unable to connect the needy people. The proposed system is creating a social awareness to avoid food wastage and rescue their waste food to poor or needy peoples. The system maintained the list of food donors and receivers and donor can provide the information regards food quality and its quantity. The social benefit of proposed system is to reduce food wastage and greenhouse gas effect.

articleTitle: Biomedical Devices: Development & Performance in Healthcare System
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Biomedical devices play a critical role in the healthcare system and positively impact patient well-being. Biomedical devices have revolutionized healthcare by providing innovative solutions for the diagnosis, treatment, and monitoring of various medical conditions. This abstract provides an overview of recent advancements in biomedical devices, highlighting their significance in improving patient outcomes and enhancing healthcare delivery. The rapid evolution of technology, including miniaturization, wireless connectivity, and smart sensors, has enabled the development of portable and wearable devices for continuous monitoring and personalized healthcare. Additionally, advancements in materials science have facilitated the creation of biocompatible and bio-resorbable devices, reducing the risk of adverse reactions and improving patient comfort. Moreover, the integration of artificial intelligence and machine learning algorithms has empowered these devices with predictive analytics capabilities, enabling early detection of diseases and personalized treatment strategies. This abstract explores the diverse applications of biomedical devices across various medical specialties, including cardiology, neurology, oncology, and orthopedics, emphasizing their role in advancing precision medicine and transforming the future of healthcare.

articleTitle: Classification of Defects in Photovoltaic Cells from Electroluminescence Images using Advanced Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: For a long time, keeping big solar power plants running has been a real challenge. This work talks about an exciting new way to detect problems in solar panels using special pictures called electroluminescence images (EL). Deep learning algorithms is used to help with this task! Our research introduces a fresh method that can automatically spot flaws by using a pre-trained deep learning Vision Transformer (ViT) model. The model is trained on ELPV Dataset with EL image, which is available for everyone. The model achieved an impressive accuracy of 94.53% on the test set! Our model was thoroughly tested against popular machine learning models like ResNet50, DenseNet, ResNet101, VGG-16, VGG-19, Inception ResNet, ResNet-152, MobileNet, and Xception. The results showed that proposed model did better than all of these earlier models. The model is compared with other top methods for finding problems in EL images. Proposed method has proved to be better than the existing models. It really showed it can accurately find flaws in electroluminescence images.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Personalization in E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The nature of e-commerce is constantly changing how the business is carried out and how things are bought. It has been made possible to do so because of technological advancements and the capacity of the internet that goes as far as allowing the customers to view, buy and get products from the ease of their homes. The idea of e-commerce has developed to cut through both the retail environment and the interface of customer expectations. This is the outcome of artificial intelligence being adopted by the e-commerce sector, namely in the area of customization. More specifically, when AI algorithms are applied, machine learning is becoming more and more significant in e-commerce customization. AI technologies keep developing further and further which enables to analyse the detailed information about the shopping habits, interests and preferences of every client so that every e-commerce unit may be able to cater to every need of a customer. This document focuses on the AI methods related to the e-commerce personalization processes: machine learning, deep learning, and natural language processing (NLP) methods. It focuses on the procedures of gathering and analysing data because these are crucial in understanding the buying patterns of consumers and what they prefer.

articleTitle: Ethical and Regulatory Consideration in AI-Assisted Drug Development
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Applying artificial intelligence (AI) to the creation of novel pharmaceuticals has created revolutionary prospects for expediting drug discovery and refining clinical trials. To guarantee responsible innovation, though, these developments raise difficult moral and legal issues that need to be resolved. The main ethical concerns surrounding AI-assisted medication development are examined in this paper, along with the difficulties in mitigating bias, algorithmic openness, and patient permission and data protection. This study examines the application of AI in medication-finding procedures, highlighting that’s function in boosting efforts in precision medicine and enhancing patient outcomes. Regulatory considerations are especially important because current frameworks frequently don't address AI technologies. The review emphasizes revising regulatory norms to account for the special features of artificial intelligence (AI), including real-time learning, validation procedures, and the incorporation of AI technologies into clinical practice. This study presents a comprehensive analysis of the interaction between artificial intelligence (AI) and regulatory frameworks, offering recommendations on how to settle moral and legal disputes to promote the development of just and safe medications.

articleTitle: Emerging Frontiers of Artificial Intelligence in Epilepsy Care: A Comprehensive Overview
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Epilepsy, a chronic neurological disorder characterized by recurrent seizures, poses significant challenges in diagnosis, treatment, and management. In recent years, Artificial Intelligence (AI) has emerged as a promising tool to revolutionize various aspects of epilepsy care. This comprehensive review explores the advancements and applications of AI in epilepsy, encompassing diagnostic support, seizure prediction, personalized treatment strategies, and therapeutic monitoring. AI techniques such as machine learning, deep learning, and natural language processing are leveraged to analyze diverse datasets including electroencephalogram (EEG) recordings, imaging studies, genetic data, and clinical records. Key applications include automated seizure detection and classification systems, predictive models for personalized treatment plans, and real-time monitoring tools to enhance patient management. Furthermore, AI-driven approaches enable integration of multimodal data to improve accuracy and reliability in epilepsy diagnosis and prognosis. Challenges such as data heterogeneity, interpretability of AI models, ethical considerations, and regulatory issues are also discussed. This review highlights the transformative potential of AI in advancing epilepsy research and clinical practice, offering insights into future directions for leveraging AI to optimize care and improve outcomes for individuals living with epilepsy.

articleTitle: Machine Learning and AI Approaches to Manufacturing Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: It is increasingly crucial to use artificial intelligence (AI) to raise the calibre of items. The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) and data mining (ML) technologies into processes is transforming the industrial sector. With a focus on discovering practical applications, this thorough research explores the quickly developing field of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning applications in business. In the production sector, businesses strive to maximize efficiency while minimizing costs. This essay discusses the fundamentals of data mining (ML) and computer science (AI), and it looks at both cutting-edge and tried-and-true ML methods used in manufacturing. Additionally featured are a variety of AI applications, such as technology, neural networks, natural language processing, vision, and continuous projections that have fundamentally transformed the industry. The paper highlights recent advancements and advancements that provide optimism for future innovation, which helps to illuminate potential applications of AI and machine learning for manufacturing. This article will prove to be a valuable resource for scholars, researchers, and executives as the manufacturing industry experiences constant transformation, thanks to its thorough analysis of the current situation, obstacles, prospects, and future directions of AI and ML applications.

articleTitle: AI Used in Healthcare and Data Privacy
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: This rapid integration of AI into healthcare systems has brought in an era of advancements in medicine from diagnostic capabilities to the most advanced treatment plans that are tailormade for a person. Great problems brought with this revolution in technology pertain to security and privacy maintenance over health data. Increasingly using vast amounts of sensitive information about patients, AI applications also increase the potential risks of data breaches or unauthorized access that raise critical ethical and legal concerns. This review article discusses in depth the role of AI in many areas of safeguarding health care data and technological innovations thereby protecting patient privacy, including federated learning, homomorphic encryption, and differential privacy. AI solutions further analysis and use of information without breaching the confidentiality of data, thus reducing many of the drawbacks correlated with the transfer and storage of data.

articleTitle: AI and Mental Health: A New Era of Healing
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Artificial intelligence is revolutionizing the field of mental health with the delivery of ingenious ways for the diagnosis, treatment, and management of these mental health illnesses. These reviews look at uses of AI in mental health ranging from cognitive behavioral treatment provided by AI-driven chatbots or virtual therapists to machine learning algorithms for early diagnosis and remote monitoring systems for the continuous evaluation of patients. Mental health services are much more powerful and effective on a large scale when joined with AI in the treatment of mental disorders. This is through the enhancement of access, accuracy, and treatment customization. AI and mental health represent two of the fastest-growing areas, both of which can potentially impact each other significantly. The rising prevalence of mental health disorders has led to an exploration of the potential remedies through AI. These are really promising for early detection, prevention, and treatment.

articleTitle: Enhanced Mammogram Images Classification Through Comprehensive CNN Parameters Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The rising incidence and death rate of breast cancer make it a serious issue. To tackle this problem, this study has applied convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) for breast cancer detection using mammography images. CNN can automatically learn hierarchical feature representations directly from raw image data. This study evaluates the performance of CNN models in predictive tasks, focusing on the impact of various parameters such as dropout rate, the number of convolutional layers, batch size, and data augmentation techniques. This study uses the mammography images dataset of CBIS-DDSM (Curated Breast Imaging Subset of Digital Database for Screening Mammography). The experimental results highlight the critical role of parameter selection in optimizing model performance.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Healthcare: AI-Powered Imaging Transforms Medical Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) has caused a paradigm change in medical imaging. The review paper explores the potential advantages, challenges, and applications of AI as it relates to medical imaging. Thanks to AI-powered technology, radiologists and other healthcare professionals now have access to sophisticated, efficient, and precise solutions that enhance patient care and diagnostic accuracy. AI is revolutionizing medical imaging and ushering in a revolutionary new era in patient care and healthcare diagnostics. This in-depth examination looks at the challenges, numerous applications, and noteworthy impacts of AI in the field of medical imaging. The ability of artificial intelligence to analyze, process, and interpret complex medical images has opened up new possibilities for researchers, clinicians, and radiologists. Included are the integration of multimodal imaging and the need for standardized protocols and guidelines. As the area of medical imaging undergoes constant change, healthcare professionals and legislators must collaborate to ensure the moral and effective implementation of AI Technology.

articleTitle: Predictive Modeling for Early Cancer Detection: A Machine Learning Approach to Prostate, Lung, and Breast Cancer
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Improving patient outcomes and lowering death rates from cancer need early identification. In this study, we use machine learning algorithms to predict three forms of cancer: prostate, lung, and breast. Lung cancer continues to be the primary cause of cancer-related mortality, while breast cancer affects women significantly worldwide. Prostate cancer is prevalent among men. By harnessing the power of machine learning techniques, our goal is to develop predictive models that can identify these cancers at an early stage, facilitating prompt intervention and treatment. Cancer research is instrumental in supporting medical treatments for patients, and machine learning is increasingly playing a vital role in cancer detection and diagnosis. As technology advances, the future holds the promise of easier cancer prediction without the need for hospital visits. Our project aims to determine the most effective algorithm among SVM and Random Forest for predicting cancer. We consider distinct attributes tailored to each cancer type, such as clump thickness for breast cancer, lifestyle factors for lung cancer, and physical attributes for prostate cancer. Users input relevant data, and our models provide predictions, such as determining benign and estimating the likelihood of being affected by lung or prostate cancer.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review of Applications of Nanomedicine for Cancer Therapy
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The life expectancy of cancer patients has not been significantly affected by recent medical developments. A cutting-edge field of cancer treatment, nanomedicine offers many well-proven drug delivery techniques. Goals: Numerous countries are now conducting research on polymer micelles. In medical settings, liposomes and other nanostructures are often used. These structures will be more valuable if they contain chemicals that help with site-specific delivery and customized release. The objective of the current review is to provide comprehensive data on nano-drugs. Nanotechnology has become a cutting-edge method of treating a wide range of ailments because of its enormous promise and successful treatment for many types of cancer. The basis of cancer is targeting, imaging, viral nanoparticles, and enhanced transport. Nanomedicine is a field of medicine with several applications in the treatment of tumours. Nanomedicines can be substituted with anticancer medications. Nanomedicines can target specific locations for the treatment of cancer because of their minuscule size, measured in manometers (nm). This increases their bioavailability and reduces the likelihood of harmful side effects. Financial savings can also come from taking prescriptions in smaller doses. Furthermore, nanotechnology is successfully applied in the synthesis of these drugs since they are created in nm sizes, which are among the earliest cut-off values for the fabrication of things connected to nanotechnology.

articleTitle: Evaluating Chloramphenicol Toxicity in Pediatric Populations
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Chloramphenicol is a potent broad-spectrum antibiotic and was commonly prescribed in severe infections particularly in children. However, its application has been limited due to setbacks, particularly its toxicity in children. The rationale for this particular literature review is to review and analyze the specifics of toxicity of chloramphenicol in children, including its mode of action, side effects and clinical implications. The toxicity of this drug is primarily hematologic; the worst side effect associated with the use of chloramphenicol is aplastic anaemia, with an incidence ranging between 1/24 500 and 1/40 800 treatment courses. This drug can also lead to grey baby syndrome, especially in babies who are new to the world with the symptoms of abdominal distention, vomiting and a peculiar greyish-blue skin colour. The other possible side effects: are neurotoxicity, and non-protocol-related complications. Due to the dangers of using the drug, the specialized physician is forced to perform a risk-benefit analysis against the potential of severe toxicity. The count of the blood cells and concentration of chloramphenicol in serum should be checked quite often in patients, who are under the therapy for a long time or who are suffering from the diseases of liver. Nevertheless, with the increase in antibiotic resistance in children, it is mandatory to assess the pros and cons of chloramphenicol to enhance the treatment intervention in this vulnerable group.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Models Comparisons on Rice Image Disease Classification Techniques: VGG16, ResNet50, and InceptionV3
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Accurately classifying plant diseases from images in agricultural disease detection is critical for timely and effective treatment. In this paper, a comparative analysis of three prominent deep learning models VGG16, ResNet50, and InceptionV3 applied to classify the rice disease by leaf of rice. A dataset of rice leaf images by Kaggle used, and each model’s performance was evaluated such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score metrics. The strengths and weaknesses of each model are analyzed based on the results found and based on the findings, future work, and practical applications in the field of agricultural technology.

articleTitle: Smart Healthcare: Early Diagnosis of Fetal Health Conditions using Machine Learning and Cardiotocographic Data
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Fetal health and early diagnosis refer to fetal development and regular contact with the mother’s uterus during pregnancy. Maximum pregnancy period complications put the fetus in a challenging situation that restricts proper growth and can result in deficiencies or death. Predicting risk factors before problems arise can help ensure a healthy pregnancy and promote appropriate fetal development. Forecasting the fetal health and growth state using a set of previously recognized patterns when creating a predictive classifier model with machine learning algorithms is essential. A fetus is an embryonic form of an unborn child that has not yet entered the world. Every three months of pregnancy are referred to as trimesters. The fetus grows and develops during this process, and regular examinations are crucial to ensure its health. There are many potential factors that could result in the newborn’s impairment or even death, which is a very serious situation that needs to be avoided. A Cardiotocography (C.T.G.), which is typically used to assess the heartbeat and uterine contractions, is one of the main techniques to assess the health of the fetus inside the womb. The doctor uses the data produced by C.T.G. test to assess the fetus state of his health and his words. However, there is space for error, making the doctors' data analysis untrustworthy. To assess the data and forecast fetal health, various machine learning and deep learning algorithms have been used. In this paper to demonstrate prediction accuracy using several categorization models and to evaluate the performance of each model.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of GitHub Commit Comments using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The proliferation of collaborative platforms like GitHub necessitates robust sentiment analysis tools to interpret developer emotions in commit comments, offering insights into project health and team dynamics. This study advances existing research by evaluating three machine learning algorithms for this task: Passive Aggressive Classifier, C-Support Vector Classifier (C-SVC) with a linear kernel, and Random Forest Classifier.We analyzed 10,000 GitHub commit comments from diverse projects spanning multiple programming languages and development periods. Performance was assessed using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. C-SVC outperformed other algorithms with 98 percent accuracy, 97 percent precision, 98 percent recall, and an F1-score of 0.975. The Random Forest Classifier achieved 96 percent accuracy, while the Passive Aggressive Classifier reached 94 percent.Our findings demonstrate C-SVC’s effectiveness for sentiment analysis in this context, surpassing previous benchmarks. Integration of this tool into development workflows could enhance team communication, enable early issue detection, and provide quantitative metrics for project emotional health. Future research should examine the generalizability of these results across various project types and explore real-time sentiment analysis in collaborative coding environments.

articleTitle: Advancing Alzheimer's Diagnosis: Performance Analysis of Deep Learning Ensembles in Medical Imaging
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Neuroimaging and deep learning have become the focus of much research for diagnosing Alzheimer's disease (AD) in recent years. Nevertheless, the limited availability of neuroimaging training data has resulted in significant overfitting issues for several deep learning models. However, the dataset was very imbalanced. To address this issue, we employed several augmentation techniques such as flipping, rotating, and zooming to balance the dataset. The ADNI dataset consisted of four classes: mild demented, moderate demented, very mild demented, and non-demented. In this work, we have proposed an ensemble of EfficientNetB2, DenseNet121, VGG16, and Xception for the diagnosis of Alzheimer at early stage. Experiment results shows that EfficientNetB2 ensemble with Xception and VGG16 performed extremely well with 99.1% and 99.4% respectively.

articleTitle: Empowering Communication: Converting Sign Language to Text Using CNN Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Language plays a crucial role in connecting people within a community. However, individuals who communicate using sign language often face barriers when interacting with those unfamiliar with it, as sign language has its own structure, grammar, and vocabulary that may not be easily understood by others. This presents a significant communication challenge. To address this, we propose a novel solution aimed at creating an autonomous system capable of translating sign language into speech or text in real time. This will be accomplished through the use of deep learning and machine learning algorithms, designed to operate on embedded devices. The dataset for this system has been split into training (90%) and testing (10%) sets. Technologies such as CNN (Convolutional Neural Networks), IoT (Internet of Things), and Python will be utilized to implement this solution.

articleTitle: Face-to-Face (F2F) Auth: A Multi-Party Environmental Authentication System for Sensitive Operations
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Face-to-Face (F2F) Auth is a multi-party environmental authentication system designed to safeguard highly sensitive operations by leveraging smartphone communication capabilities and environmental conditions. This paper presents the design, security analysis, and potential extensions of F2F Auth. The system utilizes Near-Field Communication (NFC) technology for peer authentication, requiring physical presence and explicit approval from another user. The provisioning process registers devices with the authentication server, ensuring secure key management. Realms are introduced to scope user authentication within defined groups. The analysis highlights F2F Auth’s security advantages, such as mitigating physical and network risks, simplicity of use, and resilience against compromised devices. Threat models, including malicious user coercion and device compromise, are evaluated along with potential countermeasures. Future work includes enhancing authentication security, implementing action parameters, refining domain scoping, and addressing UI deception attacks. F2F Auth offers a robust solution for multi-party environmental authentication in high-assurance systems, with potential applications in various domains requiring stringent security measures.

articleTitle: Large Language Model-based Mobile Apps in OPDs: Optimized Patient Management and Prioritization
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Long waiting times, inefficient processes, and a lack of personalized care often characterize the traditional OPD system. Mobile applications can enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of Outpatient Primary Care (OPC) services by offering features like appointment scheduling, real-time updates, and digital triage systems, reducing waiting times, optimizing resources, and delivering personalized care. By embracing these innovations, healthcare providers can meet the evolving demands of patients and deliver high-quality care that aligns with modern expectations.

articleTitle: Comparative Investigation of BOPPPS–AI Integrated Flipped Classroom Method and Conventional Teaching Method in Mechanical Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Traditional teaching methodology has several limitations when contents under teaching-learning are complex. Further, in outcome-based education (OBE), attainment of some program outcomes (PO) such as PO-2, PO-4, and PO-12 and course outcomes (CO) for these complex topics are usually obtained on lower side for the traditional teaching approach. BOPPPS-Bridge in, learning objective, Pre-test, Participatory learning Post-test, Summary is a student-oriented teaching methodology. In the presented work an innovative teaching methodology BOPPPS-Artificial intelligence (AI) integrated Flipped classroom-based method is adopted to get higher attainment of PO. Further, its advantages over conventional teaching methods are explored. 116 students from Pre final year of Mechanical Engineering at Yeshvantrao Chavan College of Engineering Nagpur (YCCE) were divided into groups of 58 students each. The first group used the conventional and the other group is the investigational group which utilized the BOPPPS-AI Integrated Flipped classroom method. AI tools like Chatbots are used by teacher for instructional delivery, developing study materials, and by the students at various stages of learning. Performance assessment of this work was done on two fronts; first comparing the attainment values of PO and CO for both methods and second based on a feedback questionnaire. From the results obtained, it is observed attainment values of PO and CO and learning satisfaction for the investigational group students is significantly higher than the conventional teaching group.

articleTitle: Model Agnostic Predictive Smart Load Balancer in Microservices Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: This paper presents a model-agnostic predictive smart load balancer for microservices environments, utilizing machine learning to optimize load distribution and resource utilization. The system leverages access logs from NASA, Calgary, and Clarknet datasets to categorize requests and estimate service times for various request types. Advanced ML models, including LSTM, GRU, RNN, ARIMA, and SARIMA, are employed to predict future loads on microservice instances. The load balancer uses these predictions to make proactive decisions, redirecting requests using a weighted round-robin algorithm and preemptively creating new instances when necessary. This approach ensures efficient handling of incoming requests, reduces wait times, and prevents resource over-provisioning. The system’s model-agnostic design allows for seamless integration of new ML models, enhancing its flexibility and robustness. Experimental results demonstrate significant improvements in load management and cost optimization compared to traditional load balancers, highlighting the effectiveness of incorporating ML for intelligent load balancing.

articleTitle: SMART Kitchen Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The emergence of smart technology has ushered in a paradigm shift in how we approach daily tasks, notably in the realm of cooking and kitchen interactions. This research endeavors to delve into the concept of a SMART kitchen, a cutting-edge culinary environment seamlessly integrating advanced technologies. Discussion within the paper encompasses the foundational design principles, pivotal components, and multifaceted functionalities intrinsic to SMART kitchens. Additionally, the study meticulously examines the potential advantages and obstacles entailed in deploying such innovative culinary spaces.A significant facet of this research entails the presentation and evaluation of a prototype SMART kitchen implementation. Through meticulous surveys and comprehensive user feedback analysis, the paper rigorously assesses the performance and user acceptance of the SMART kitchen model. Findings unveiled through this empirical investigation underscore the transformative potential of SMART kitchen technologies. Notably, they highlight marked enhancements in cooking efficiency, convenience, and safety, alongside fostering a culture of innovation within the culinary landscape.Ultimately, this research serves as a pivotal contribution to the evolving discourse surrounding SMART kitchens, shedding light on their transformative impact on domestic culinary experiences and laying the groundwork for future advancements in the field.

articleTitle: Enhancing Adversarial Robustness in AI Systems: A Novel Defense Mechanism Using Stable Diffusion
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Recent advancements in adversarial machine learning underscore the need for robust defenses against sophisticated attacks that compromise AI systems’ reliability. Existing frameworks, such as AI Guardian, offer valuable defenses but often rely on assumptions that can limit their effectiveness, such as incorporating adversarial examples into training data and expecting attacks to be directional. This paper introduces an innovative approach to adversarial defense that diverges from traditional methods by proposing a defense strategy based on stable diffusion[1], [2]. Our method avoids training with adversarial examples and instead leverages continuous learning and comprehensive threat modeling to build inherently resilient AI systems. By addressing the limitations of existing defenses and emphasizing a dynamic, adaptive strategy, our approach aims to provide a more generalized and robust solution to adversarial threats. We present the theoretical underpinnings, experimental design, and anticipated benefits of our approach, with a focus on enhancing AI security and adaptability against unpredictable adversarial attacks[3], [4].

articleTitle: Wearable Technology and Its Effect on the Provision of Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: By facilitating on-going health monitoring and offering real-time data to support early disease detection and prevention, wearable technology is completely changing the healthcare industry. Vital indications like heart rate, physical activity, and other important health parameters can be remotely monitored by devices like fitness trackers, smart watches, and augmented reality (AR) headsets. This technology improves patient outcomes by enabling healthcare practitioners to give prompt, personalised care when integrated with electronic health records (EHRs). By seeing possible health problems before they worsen, these wearable’s not only help proactive healthcare but also provide individuals greater control over how actively they manage their own health. Wearable technology gives medical practitioners accurate, current insights that enable more deliberate and focused decision-making by seamlessly gathering and transferring data. The present use of wearable technology in healthcare is examined in this study, along with its advantages, disadvantages, and prospects for enhancing patient care going forward. The delivery of healthcare could be revolutionised by the integration of various technologies, becoming more patient-centered, responsive, and efficient.

articleTitle: Concrete Crack Detection Using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Each year, large sums of money, amounting to hundreds of dollars are used for the repair of roads, bridges, housing and many other urgent problems. Urban structures are also heavily damaged due to several natural catastrophes like floods and earthquakes. This preservation procedure includes making visual examinations and appraisals of the distressed structure, as well as the function and condition of the operating facilities like hospitals. Such destruction may come in form of fissures which weaken or threaten the very foundation of the building. Literature search for the purpose of acquiring fresh insights is not an easy exercise. A lot of strategies have changed and many of them require changing to be useful because of the many people that they requireThis article highlights the results of a defined procedure given in the internal report with a vibration generator. It further explains the results of the external crack detection based on Python. The observations made suggest that this method can find fissures in the order of nearly 90-95 % accuracy.

articleTitle: Edge Computing and fog computing for Health care and engineering System
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The fog and edge computing architecture framework states that the network components positioned between devices and the cloud compute application-oriented processes. More smart gadgets are being added to the network as a result of the Internet of Everything's (IoE) rapid growth. This results in massive data volumes, which have led to problems with traditional cloud computing models such as inadequate privacy protection, sluggish reaction times, and bandwidth congestion. Edge computing solutions emerged because traditional cloud computing is no longer able to meet the many data processing requirements of today's intelligent society. It is a new paradigm for computing that allows calculations to be done at the edge of the network. Fog computing is a paradigm that leverages the advantages of utilizing cloud and edge devices to support contemporary computer systems. It does this by providing high-quality services, reducing latency, enabling mobility, supporting multi-tenancy, and many other aspects. Other names for it are fogging or fog networking. This article discusses edge computing, its architecture, its main technologies, and the ways in which it differs from edge computing as well as fog computing.

articleTitle: Medical Image Visualization using Augmented Reality
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Medical imaging is used to examine internal structures hidden by the skin and bones, to diagnose and treat disease in the human body. Medical imaging techniques such Computed Tomography (CT scan) and Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) are commonly used when highly detailed cross-sectional images are required for diagnostic purposes. Creating a 3D image or object from 2D images of these modalities is typically achieved by reconstruction of multiple 2D slices or projections and combined to form a thorough view of a body’s internal organ or structure. 2D Images from CT or MRI Scan are stored as DICOM File Type, method used to convert DICOM file set to 3D object is called volume rendering technique. The fusion of 3D imaging with Augmented Reality (AR) and Virtual Reality (VR), called Mixed Reality (MR), technologies completely revolutionize medical education, surgical planning, and patient interaction. As part of project study and research, a prototype software application for android systems is developed as a proof of concept. A DICOM File Set of scapula bone is used to create a 3D Holographic Object of a human bone structure and projected into the real world. Market research of such software is conducted as part of the study to tap accurately the requirements, usage as well as limitations of the developed software application prototype.

articleTitle: Intelligent Approach for Anomaly Detection using Machine learning Techniques in Industrial Control system
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Anomaly detection is crucial for cybersecurity in industrial control systems due to the continuous injection of malicious payloads by attackers. This study examines the effectiveness of various machine learning algorithms in identifying these payloads throughout the system. The experiments utilize three datasets: the Hardware in Loop HAI dataset, the Gas Pipeline dataset, and the ICS cyber-attack dataset. Python programming and a high-performance GPU facilitate the experimental procedures. This comprehensive analysis, based on these experiments, highlights that the CNN-Dense net and Random Forest algorithms deliver the highest performance in terms of accuracy, precision, recall, and Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) curve across all datasets. It is important to note that other algorithms also perform comparably to CNN-Dense net and Random Forest. Consequently, the choice of machine learning algorithm should be guided by the specific data generated by the application system.

articleTitle: Predicting Heart Disease: A Machine Learning Approach to Cardiac Health
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Heart disease continues to be a major worldwide health problem, taking many lives annually. Reducing death rates and moving forward persistent results depend heavily on early recognizable proof and anticipation. Conventional techniques for diagnosing cardiac disease can be time-consuming and can require intrusive strategies. Machine learning has ended up a practical strategy for handling these issues in later a long time. Machine learning calculations are able of distinguishing patterns and making exceptionally exact forecasts almost the possibility of cardiac infection by assessing enormous databases of persistent data. This study looks into how machine learning may be utilized to estimate the hazard of heart infection depending on distinctive quiet characteristics. A huge dataset was utilized, which included details approximately blood weight, cholesterol, age, gender, smoking status, and the presence of certain medical disorders. Through the utilize of cutting-edge machine learning strategies such as Random Forest, Support Vector Machine, and Neural Networks, our goal was to make models that may dependably distinguish individuals as either tall or low chance heart malady patients. The comes about of this think about illustrate how machine learning has the capacity to totally change the field of heart illness anticipation. Healthcare experts can act early with focused interventions, such as pharmaceutical, lifestyle changes, or more advanced demonstrative strategies, by accurately recognizing those who are at high risk. This individualized approach to treatment can lower the overall burden of heart illness and enormously upgrade understanding results. This study appears how well machine learning can anticipate the hazard of heart infection. In specific, the Random Forest demonstrate turned out to be a valuable asset for deciding which individuals would benefit from early mediation. We may expect the advancement of continuously more complex and precise models as machine learning innovation advances, which can improve our capacity to treat cardiac infection.

articleTitle: Designing of Creator’s Information Hub using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The proliferation of educational content on platforms like YouTube has transformed digital learning, yet it presents challenges in effective creation, dissemination, and impact assessment. This paper proposes a strategic initiative to collaborate with 6,000 active educational YouTubers to enhance global educational outreach. Central to this initiative is the compilation and analysis of a comprehensive dataset containing vital information about content creators and their audiences. Leveraging advanced machine learning algorithms, the analysis aims to identify collaboration opportunities, optimize engagement strategies, enhance content relevance and impact, facilitate knowledge sharing, and measure outcomes. The problem statement highlights fragmentation in educational content, lack of data-driven insights, and suboptimal collaboration opportunities. Addressing these challenges requires a structured approach to connect creators, leverage data analytics, and establish a collaborative ecosystem for enriching educational experiences worldwide.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Approach for Fast Detection of COVID-19 using Lung X-ray Scans
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: In the pandemic situations, when multiple strains of coronavirus are still a concern, RT-PCR is a lengthy manual testing technique that can take anywhere from a few hours to two days to complete. The system aims to develop a model that is based on radiology. For the purpose of detection, the coronavirus is detected using X-ray imaging. This proposed methodology is to identify patients whose x-rays are taken. Check to see if they are infected with COVID-19. The data collection includes pneumonia X-rays, normal and Covid-19 X-rays patients. This research includes the implementation of VGG19, Inception V3, and ResNet-50. Convolution Neural Network (CNN) models play a critical role in image classification. Different metrics are used to evaluate the model.

articleTitle: Mobile App for Enhancing Accessibility Among the Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Over the last few years, technological advancements in mobile applications have significantly improved the quality of life for individuals with vision impairments. However, even today, there remains a significant gap in accessibility and usability for people with visual impairments. Many current apps lack the necessary accuracy, suffer from high latency, and are not easy to use. This paper presents an innovative mobile application designed specifically for blind users. The app enables users to interact with their environment and perform tasks more efficiently and is equipped with advanced AI-driven real-time object recognition, real-time text extraction, and real-time currency detection. This application addresses existing accessibility challenges, offering faster, more accurate, and user-friendly solutions that enhance autonomy and confidence among visually impaired users.

articleTitle: Integrating 4QS Factors to Enhance Learning Quality Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The ultimate goal of any educational institution is to offer the best educational experience and impart knowledge effectively to students. Identifying students who need extra support and taking appropriate actions to enhance their performance is crucial in achieving this goal. This study explores the application of machine learning techniques to predict students' final grades based on their historical data. The proposed strategy integrates the 4QS Model, which focuses on intelligence, adversity, spirituality, emotional, and stress factors to address essential aspects of the academic environment. By targeting these key factors, the aim is to improve the teaching and learning environment, leading to enhanced student performance and future success. This approach enables educators to identify areas where students may struggle and tailor their teaching methods accordingly, resulting in a more effective and supportive educational experience for both faculty and students. A classification machine learning algorithm was employed to predict student performance.

articleTitle: The Advancements and Benefits of AI-Assisted Robotic Surgery
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The concept of robots, which was first introduced by Karel Čapek’s term "robot," has undergone a substantial transformation from the execution of simple, tedious duties to the execution of intricate, precise operations. Robots have been incorporated into the medical and hazardous sectors due to technological advancements. The Zeus and da Vinci platforms were commercially available by the late 1990s, following the emergence of surgical robotics at NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory in the late 1980s. These systems revolutionized minimally invasive surgery (MIS) by providing advantages such as improved precision, quicker recovery, and reduced infection risk. The da Vinci system, which received FDA approvals from 2000 to 2005, continues to be essential in robotic surgery. Modern advancements, such as the integration of AI, enhanced imaging, and miniaturization, have been instrumental in the enhancement of procedural efficiency and surgical outcomes. The proficiency of surgeons in robotic-assisted procedures is guaranteed by the continuous advancement of training techniques. Future orientations will concentrate on the integration of AI and the resolution of ethical and regulatory challenges in robotic surgery.

articleTitle: Generative Modeling Techniques for Simulating Rare Agricultural Events on Prediction of Wheat Yield Production
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Wheat yield prediction is key to food security and optimal resource use. In this paper, Generative AI is use for specifically GANs and VAEs, to predict wheat yield under different weather conditions, uses the crop yield prediction dataset from Kaggle which has temperature, rainfall and soil quality as parameters and build models that beat traditional statistical methods. By leveraging advanced AI models, such as Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and Variational Autoencoders (VAEs), the model generates synthetic data that mimics these rare occurrences. The GAN generates synthetic data that enriches the training set and improves prediction accuracy. The VAE captures the complex non-linear relationships between input features and output. The combination of both models gives us a robust framework for yield prediction. Experimental results shows that the GAN dataset gives 14% improvement over baseline models. VAE model gives 13% improvement on its own, showing its ability to handle the variability and complexity of agricultural data. This dual model approach is a big leap in agricultural analytics and will enable more robust and adaptive farming in the face of climate change.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Automatic Rice Transplanter Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: This project addresses the need for improved agricultural productivity by designing a cost-effective automatic rice transplanter for small-scale farmers in economically constrained regions, such as India. The focus is on creating a machine that reduces the labor-intensive nature of paddy farming, allowing labor reallocation to other sectors. The design prioritizes simplicity and cost-effectiveness, utilizing lightweight materials and a straightforward planting mechanism to automate seedling transplantation. Field testing under diverse paddy field conditions validates the machine's performance. Farmer feedback guides design refinements for practicality, efficiency, and ease of operation.
