In conclusion, the development of this affordable automatic rice transplanter has the potential to revolutionize small-scale paddy farming, fostering increased productivity and facilitating economic growth by freeing up the agricultural workforce for other sectors.

articleTitle: Real-time inverse kinematics function generation using (GANs) and advanced computer vision for Robotics joints
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: This research presents a novel approach for real-time inverse kinematic function generation for robotic joints using Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) integrated with advanced computer vision techniques. This project includes an automated [15] model that moves based on human hand movements. The system uses Modern computer vision techniques to precisely interpret human hand motions, which enables a robot to imitate hand movements in real-time, mainly in the X and Y axes. The proposed technique leverages GANs for modeling complex, high-dimensional kinematic transformations, allowing for accurate and effortless computation of joint configurations determined by end-effector positions. Thus, if a human hand performs a wave motion, the robotic arm will move from left to right, replicating the wave action. Using sensors, inverse kinematics, and AI/ML algorithms, the outcome shows significant improvements in motion accuracy and computational efficiency over usual inverse kinematic solutions, showcasing the model’s potential in human-robot interactions.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of Mental Illness using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Mental health dynamics have also been affected with significant changes by the digital age with the changes in the way people interact, work, or get information. What has emerged over the last decade, while information technologies such as social media, mobile applications, and telemedicine in the broad sense contain the potential for increasing awareness, availability, and support for individuals with mental health problems, new risks also appear. Screens are addictive, and increased use of social media can result in cyberbullying and social comparison, spreading of fake news which causes anxiety, depression, anxiety and other mental illnesses. On the other hand, as found in the digital contexts, there are support networks, opportunities to plan early intervention, along with mental health literacy. The current study discusses the twofold nature of the effects of digital technology on mental health and how both positive and negative outcomes should be used as the guide for the use of technology in the improvement of mental health. It raises awareness of digital literacy that is necessary to teach people healthy virtual behaviors and discussion of mental-health issues to contribute to the creation of a positive online culture. Given that the process advances daily, it also becomes necessary to assess the influence of digital environment on mental health and work on shielding from potential dangers while enhancing advantages

articleTitle: Optical Flow Self-Teaching in Multi-Frame with Full-Image Warping via Unsupervised Recurrent All-Pairs Field Transform
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: A self-teaching algorithm is used for learning optical flow with non-occlusion and full-image wrapping from geometry. The proposed algorithm uses a monocular camera in order to learn the optimal state-of-the-art optical flow. It is based on a novel approach which uses the camera calibration parameters to directly optimize the flow. In this way, the algorithm is able to learn the full image-space motion from a single image pair. The proposed approach is evaluated on several datasets and is shown to be competitive with state-of-the-art supervised learning methods. The main benefits of the proposed approach is that it does not require large datasets for training and is able to leverage the natural geometric constraints of the scene to obtain the best possible results. The proposed algorithm is also able to produce more spatially consistent optical flow than existing deep learning approaches

articleTitle: The Role of AI in Medical Imaging Diagnostic
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) in medical imaging are already widening since they: Deep learning algorithms, combined with large sets of data, allow AI systems, to, for instance, review X-rays, MRIs, and CT scans to identify patterns linked with sicknesses. This capability is useful in detecting and diagnosing diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular diseases, very much useful to radiologists. AI can process much data much faster than a man and therefore takes much workload of the health practitioners eliminating human errors. In addition, these algorithms are trained from various databases, and therefore can develop and advance with the new imaging methods and diseases. This flexibility is central to the thinking that characterizes the process of designing personalized medicine, and the findings support treatment plans. However, there are concerns in incorporating AI in medical imaging some of which are; privacy and confidentiality of patient information, need for high levels of accreditation, and concerns over further removal of human touch in patient treatment plans. Realization of AI potential is an area that has been presented as a great challenge and, in order to fully optimize the outcomes, it will be necessary to address these challenges. The emphasis is made on the fact that with the gradual progress of scientific developments, AI will intensively influence the daily diagnostic practices, enhancing the effectiveness of healthcare and the quality of patients’ lives.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review of Machine Learning techniques used for Designing An Academic Result Predictor And Identifying The Multi-Dimensional Factors Affecting Student's Academic Results
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: In today's era of data explosion, the vast amounts of generated data offer valuable insights for stakeholders if effectively utilized. In the educational sector, analyzing this data with Machine Learning, particularly through Educational Data Mining (EDM), can help educators make informed decisions and improve academic strategies. This study uses EDM to address poor academic performance—a major factor in youth depression and low college passing rates—by employing predictive analytics to forecast student outcomes. It evaluates six classification algorithms—Random Forest, Decision Tree, SVM, KNN, XGBoost, and Naive Bayes—using a dataset that includes academic, personal, college, and family factors. The study also assesses feature importance and presents performance metrics for each model to optimize academic performance predictions

articleTitle: Adaptive Conversation Recommendation Systems: Leveraging Large Language Models and Knowledge Graphs
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel conversation recommendation system that leverages large language models (LLMs) and knowledge graphs (KGs) to enhance recommendation accuracy and adaptability. Our system dynamically analyzes user queries using LLMs, decomposing them into meaningful graph nodes within a reference KG like YAGO. These nodes then form the basis of personalized user-centric KGs, representing individual preferences. Node weights are adjusted based on ongoing conversations, capturing evolving user intent. To ensure relevance, decay rate factor is implemented to reduce weights on less frequently utilized nodes. This dual mechanism allows our system to provide increasingly relevant recommendations while adapting to changing user interests. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, showcasing improved recommendation performance compared to traditional methods.

articleTitle: Predictive Modelling of Heart Disease and the Role of Comorbidities in Patient Outcome
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Heart disease is one of the major worldwide health issues, and machine learning presents exciting opportunities for the medical field for early diagnosis and to improve prediction accuracy. This work aims to create a predictive model for heart disease based on machine learning. To do this, we used data from UCI and PhysioNet. We attempted to learn more about how comorbid medical disorders affect patient readmission and mortality rates by investigating their effects. A maximum accuracy of 88.52% was achieved in our studies utilizing a variety of methodologies, indicating the potential of machine learning in this field. An important finding from our analysis of patient data related to heart failure is that the readmission and mortality rates increase with the number of comorbidities. This highlights the importance of thorough patient monitoring and preventive care practices. These findings show the importance of machine learning in diagnosing high-risk patients and directing clinical judgment, which ultimately leads to better health outcomes and more effective healthcare administration systems around the world.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Models and Medical Data Analysis: An Experiment
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Cardiovascular diseases (CVD) still constitute the leading causes of death and morbidity throughout the world, becoming more concerned with public health problems, especially in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). If we can detect heart conditions early, then we would be able to decrease the mortality rates caused by them. The accurate diagnosis of heart diseases is challenging particularly because that testing demands considerable expertise, time, and knowledge from healthcare professionals. This case of the women should remind us that we need more AI powered technologies to risk-stratify these high-risk cardiovascular patients, and provide them a means to efficiently predict the future outcome. In the event high risk populations can be identified, early interventions such as changes in diet and statin therapy may be used to advance primary prevention of CVD. The main goals of this study were to evaluate six machine learning models K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Support Vector Classifier (SVC), XGBoost, Logistic Regression (LR), Decision Tree, and Random Forest (RF). The leader of the field was KNN, with an accuracy of around 86% followed by the SVC model. However, other models also have produced nearly equal results on the same dataset.

articleTitle: Career Navigator: Your AI Career Counselor
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Career planning for college students is significantly influenced by career choices, which can be a daunting decision in today's society. Many students are uncertain about their future paths despite having various talents and skills. Our innovative approach to student career advising integrates machine learning (ML) for job prediction with a user-friendly chatbot interface, aiming to provide a comprehensive solution to this issue. The ML-based career prediction model analyzes several factors, including students' talents, educational backgrounds, and interests. We compared three ML algorithms—KNN, Random Forest, and Decision Tree—finding KNN to be the most accurate with a 97% success rate. The application, developed using Flutter and Google API, features a chatbot that answers career-related queries, allows appointment bookings, and includes a FAQ page. The website, designed with Flask, HTML, Jinja2, and Scikit-learn, offers a login system and a career prediction tool that assesses users' proficiency in various fields through a series of questions. It then suggests appropriate job fields, necessary skills, job locations, salary information, and relevant courses, enhancing the overall career counseling experience. This dual strategy ensures students receive dynamic and personalized guidance, helping them make informed decisions about their professional futures.

articleTitle: DermDetectNet: Identifying Skin Diseases with Advanced Computer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Skin problems are a difficult issue in medicine because there are many different types and they can look very different from each other. This study is trying to solve this problem by creating a smart system that can automatically recognize and handle skin issues using special computer programs called machine learning algorithms. The main aim of this project is to build a strong system that can correctly identify skin conditions from pictures of the skin. To do this, we gather a large collection of skin images showing many different skin problems to cover all types of skin conditions. We then use advanced methods to analyze and sort these images, helping to tell one skin problem from another based on how they look. The system's performance and trustworthiness are carefully checked and confirmed using various tests and real-life situations. These evaluations show that the suggested system could be a useful tool for diagnosing and planning treatments for skin conditions. It gives medical professionals a quick and precise way to tackle the complex issues related to skin diseases.

articleTitle: A Multimodal Approach for Skin Lesion Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Inspection by dermatologists remains the standard for skin cancer diagnosis, but it can be subjective and prone to error. We explore the potential of machine learning for dermoscopic image classification using 10,000 pigmented skin lesions. Although convolutional neural networks are powerful tools for skin lesion classification by themselves, by incorporating patient-specific textual data, we aim to improve the accuracy and accessibility of diagnosis. We propose multiple multimodal models: transfer learning and multimodal transformers. These multimodal approaches aim to utilise both dermoscopic images and corresponding patient-specific data, such as lesion location and patient demographics. Our multimodal model with the best overall evaluation is the multimodal transformer model which combines a vision transformer and a text transformer. It achieved an accuracy of 93.21% and an AUROC of 0.9860.

articleTitle: Extreme Inception Model and Its Application in Indian Food Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: In our increasingly digital world, the ability to analyze and interpret images has become indispensable. Image classification, a fundamental task in computer vision, plays a pivotal role in various domains including healthcare, automotive, security, and entertainment. Transfer learning, particularly useful when data is limited, has become a popular approach for optimizing pre-trained models for specific tasks. One prominent model in this area is Xception (Extreme Inception), which represents a significant advancement in deep learning architectures. Xception provides a powerful alternative to traditional convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for image-related tasks, delivering strong performance while being computationally efficient. An important factor in situations where high precision is needed when computational resources are scarce is Xception’s robust performance and economical architecture. The use of the Xception model with ImageNet weight is indicated in this work. Here, the database of the images comprising of 18 distinct Indian food images for training and validation purpose. The images are preprocess using data augmentation process the proposed model Yields 99 percent accuracy which is highly acceptable. Additionally, the achieved accuracy is evaluated against the state-of-the-art methods, showing that our exception model outperforms all other techniques.

articleTitle: A Novel Consensus Algorithm for Improving Mining Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: It is required to safeguard the safety of Electronic Health Records (EHR) in a number of different areas, such as the authentication of users, the protection of patient privacy, and the backup and restoration of data. Academics have suggested a significant number of unique algorithmic methods as a way of accomplishing the aforementioned goals. The proposed a technique for maintaining Electronic Health Records (EHR) is based on blockchain technology in order to cut down on the number of instances and the problem that arises with the centralized and decentralized data systems. The proposed work uses the Novel Consensus Algorithm for improving the mining efficiency. This model that has been provided serves as a foundation for the creation of an innovative semi-centralized strategy for the provision of EHR security

articleTitle: HOG-Based Feature Extraction for Accurate Modi Script Character Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Modi is an old script used for documentation in Maharashtra that dates to the 17th century. With time the writing style of the script changes, and a lot of variation occurred till date. In the 20th century, due to a lack of awareness and understanding about the Modi-script, it disappeared and was replaced by the Devanagari. Manuscripts with Modi-script have not yet been explored, the information present in it remains unrevealed. To unfold the knowledge and develop a HOCR method for recognizing Modi characters, first need to understand the structural features of Modi characters. The main aim of this paper is to explore the structural features of the Modi characters that help in extracting the features.

articleTitle: AI for Healthcare Data Security and Privacy
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The healthcare industry, along with all its subsectors, is dealing with an unparalleled quantity of data due to the efforts of pharmaceutical firms, healthcare facilities, and health insurance providers. The massive privacy and security issues prevent the healthcare industry from properly utilizing this data with its present assets, even if it's praised as the means of enhancing patient health, getting important insights, and reducing costs. However, the success of any healthcare business depends on the management and use of big data. The goal of this study is to provide the latest privacy and security for large data issues as they apply to healthcare organizations. Some of current issues with data security, privacy, and user access protocols are the focus of this study.

articleTitle: CNN-LSTM Model for Deepfake Image Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Deepfakes are a powerful tool for producing artificial media that can convincingly mimic real content, raising concerns about its potential misuse for spreading misinformation and manipulating public opinion. Detecting deepfake images has become a critical research area, with numerous techniques developed using deep learning methods. This study presents a strategy for spotting deepfake images with a model that combines convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and long short-term memory (LSTM). The combination blends CNNs' spatial awareness with LSTMs' grasp of temporal context. Through successful performance on accessible datasets, the developed approach achieves an accuracy rate of 98.20%, showcasing its ability to accurately discern deepfake images while maintaining a low false-positive output. With an error of 0.28%, the model highlights the complexities and challenges in deepfake detection. The results emphasize the effectiveness of utilizing combined deep learning techniques in addressing the critical problem of precisely detecting manipulated images.

articleTitle: Generation of Video Subtitles for All Video Creators
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: With closed captions, those with hearing impairments may easily follow the information in videos, making them an essential accessibility tool. Nevertheless, the process of making subtitles can be costly and time-consuming. Making video subtitles automatically is a promising way to lower the cost and increase accessibility of subtitles. In this project, we create and assess a system for automatically captioning videos. Our method converts audio from video using the most sophisticated speech recognition model. After that, we apply a range of post-processing methods to enhance the quality of the subtitles, including mistake correction, text segmentation, and timestamp addition. We test our system on a video dataset with numerous speakers, diverse accents, and background noise, among other auditory circumstances. We also do a comparison between our method and other cutting-edge video subtitling systems. Our findings demonstrate that our technology performs competitively across the board. We also discovered that our algorithm can produce understandable, crisp subtitles. We are confident that our system can have a major impact on the automatic video captioning industry.

articleTitle: Advancing Fake News Detection: A Comparative Analysis of SVM and LR Models and Prospects for Dynamic Model Updating
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Fake news has grown to be a significant issue in the present digital era, affecting both public opinion and information accuracy. Creating effective detection models that can distinguish between fake and real information is essential to getting beyond that obstacle. To identify fake news, we conducted an analysis of two well-known ML techniques, Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Logistic Regression (LR), in this research. We used an extensive data set having real news stories and their fake equivalents. By means of preprocessing methods including tokenization, stemming, and feature engineering, we derive meaningful information from the raw material. We next used the processed dataset to train SVM and LR classifiers, using different configurations for the detection of fake news. Evaluation measures that calculate the models' efficiency in differentiating between fake and real news include precision, F1-score, recall, and accuracy. Our test results demonstrate the effectiveness of both SVM and LR in identifying fake news, with SVM demonstrating somewhat superior accuracy rates in several cases. LR, however, performs competitively, especially where interpretability and computational efficiency are paramount. We intend to present a new approach to dynamic model updating in the future, in which real time data will be routinely and methodically added to the detection model. By enhancing the capacity of the model to recognize new types of disinformation, this adaptive approach seeks to increase the model's overall relevance and accuracy in real-time identification of fake news.

articleTitle: Development of a Smart Car Parking System
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: This paper discusses how the Internet of Things (IoT) can help solve parking problems in urban areas by proposing a comprehensive smart parking approach comprising three major components: a parking management application, customer-managing systems, and an Internet-of-Things enabling platform. To detect vacancies and alert drivers to them[1]. The system reduces idle time spent looking for free spaces during peak seasons or holidays by offering real-time updates, making driving around town less confusing and time-consuming. As smart cities continue to expand, managing this growth is no simple task. It is already evident that they need smart parking systems more than ever before. Thus data exchange between sensor equipment and portable devices takes place through collaboration among hardware with software resources within a single unit or module [5]. The abstract emphasizes the significance of IoT-based friendly smart ensemble systems to help improve parking administration processes, lower transportation delays on the roadways plus enhance user experience behind the wheel substantially within growing metropolis areas like these.

articleTitle: AI in Precision Medicine
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The advancement of artificial intelligent (AI) and artificial intelligence (ML) to be technologies in the discipline of personalised medicine is currently causing a significant upheaval in the healthcare sector. This transforms the finding of solutions for the information that is on the patients to get better treatment outcomes. This study explores new achievements in these areas concentrating on AI and ML used within precision medicine, for instance, digital photograph analysis, single-cell investigations, and virtual screening. The introduction of AI and ML technologies leading to an enhancement of deep learning has been a significant result of large-scale datasets and computational technological breakthroughs in the research area, especially in the places of confinement, i.e., in the graphic processing units (GPUs) is the study that explores AI in precision medicine, encouraging the initiative to adopt the considerations in the ethical uses of AI and the diversified usage of data.

Author Keywords: Deep Neural Networks (DNN). Virtual Biomarkers Screens

articleTitle: Predictive Maintenance: Machine Learning Approaches for Enhanced Equipment Reliability
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Predictive maintenance is an innovative approach that predicts equipment failure before it happens to allow organizations to schedule the maintenance activities at optimal times. The strategy eliminates unexpected downtime and overall operational costs, so it is one of the most effective solutions in industries with on-going continuous machinery operation. In this paper, machine learning techniques in predictive maintenance using the publicly available data from Kaggle is examined. The proposed work investigates critical steps undertaken for the development of PdM systems-including data preprocessing, feature engineering, model selection, and evaluation. Due care is taken at every stage to enhance predictive accuracy and reliability as effective data preparation and relevant feature extraction are essential to the success of a model. Several models are tested and compared, the best one coming out to be the Random Forest classifier. This model achieves the highest accuracy at 96 percent, though its precision, at 93 percent, is slightly less than that of some other models. These results show that it is indispensable to balance accuracy and precision to realize the potential of PdM. This study has shown how predictive analytics based on ML significantly strengthen maintenance strategies by making decisions based on data, thereby saving time, money, and preventing machinery from breaking down when least expected.

articleTitle: Soft Computing Tools to Enhance Classroom Learning and Team Empathy of Learners
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: College is a bastion of skill enhancement. Skilled individuals coming from here, provides their services to business, professional services, policy making and many more. They handle delicate issues in the society on a wide scale. It is important for them to be proficient in their skill. To create such individuals in the college who are proficient in their skills and socially complete, is complicated job. Untangling it, trainers in college must need skill development tools, just like hoe, hammer, the tool that make most of your everyday tasks easier. In this paper we proposed application of some well known soft tools with blend of soft computing technology to make learning in college easier and fruitful. By doing, we try to describe computers as a learning partner of learner, to enhance skill, and empathy in classroom learning.

articleTitle: Interdisciplinary Research Scope for Electronic Nose
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The electronic nose (E-nose), a replica of the biological olfactory system, has emerged as a safe and useful instrument in nearly every industry, from pharmaceuticals to agriculture, food quality inspections, and more. E-noses imitate the human ability to identify volatile organic compounds (VOCs) through innovative chemical sensors, data acquisition, effective signal processing, and pattern recognition techniques. As a result, the collaboration between engineers specializing in material science and computer/electronic science has advanced the creation of novel sensors and materials, improved framework analysis, and raised the selectivity and sensitivity of E-nose systems. These advancements have made it possible for several industries, including healthcare, to monitor patients without requiring invasive procedures, as well as for real-time quality checks in agriculture, fresh food assurance, and medication quality assurance. E-nose technology has the potential to play a major role in improving safety, productivity, and environmental friendliness in these industries in the years to come. Considering the data regarding the current and future states of E-nose technology, its interdisciplinary application, and its focus on the technology’s advancement, its efficacy is highlighted as a crucial offer to fundamentally transform numerous sectors by providing fresh and efficient solutions.

articleTitle: Drug Discovery and Development Process
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: It is the process used in the identification of a molecule that may be used therapeutically to treat and cure sickness. Various methods in drug discovery involve candidate identification, synthesis, characterization, and validation; optimization; screening; and testing for therapeutic efficacy. Should the compound prove very promising in these researches, then a medication development process will start before the clinical trials. A new drug has to pass several phases of development before it can be generated into a safe and efficient treatment that is to follow all the regulatory requirements. We have, in this paper, argued succulently against the multiplicity of biological targets for screening of a new pharmaceutical for its licensure—a prolonged, intricate, and dear process. It may also be necessary to procure new research tools in such a way that every new target is scrutinized properly. A scientific discovery needs time-to-time development into a drug that is profitable. The time from discovery to an approved drug ranges between 12 to 15 years and requires the spending of $1 billion US. On average, a million molecules are assessed and one will rise through the higher levels of the clinical trials to be available for patients. This paper describes the outline of discovering and developing novel drugs.

articleTitle: Enhance Quality and Quantity yield Measuring Technique for Fruit Farming
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: This Fruit farming plays an important role in agricultural ecosystem. In fruit farming there are various types of fruits will be produced with innovative technologies in market. Due to technology the farming production is atomized and will help us to produce the large quantity of the fruits. As per the study scene there is no automation develop to analyzing the quality of the fruits. The analysis of fruit quality will play an important role to embed AI technologies in farming. There are various techniques available for fruit detection and calculating numbers of fruits to the particular plant. As survey the quantity of fruits can be determine but quantity of quality fruits unable to find. So, the proposed mechanism will help to classify the detected fruits in good and bad quality.

articleTitle: Speculation Of Lung Cancer Using Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Timely identification of lung cancer can save the life of a patient. However, lung cancer is often not identified until it has reached advanced stages, where it may have already spread beyond the lungs, complicating treatment efforts. Due to its high mortality rate, lung cancer remains significant global health concern, making early detection crucial for effective treatment and improved patient survival rates. Tissue biopsy is frequently required to confirm a lung cancer diagnosis and to determine its type and stage. Computed tomography (CT) scans are commonly used in lung cancer diagnosis because of their high resolution and sensitivity in detecting lung nodules. Recent advancements in machine learning, particularly in neural networks like Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) is useful to increase the accuracy as well as efficiency of diagnosing and classifying lung nodules in CT scans. This article reviews and analyzes recent techniques in cancer diagnosis using machine learning, w focusing on CNNs for CT scan images. It covers methods using CNNs, including data preparation, model parameters, training strategies, and performance evaluation.

articleTitle: A Semantic Retrieval System Using Imager Histogram Computation to reduce Trademark infringement based on the conceptual similarity of text
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
