articleTitle: Development of an Efficient Supervised Machine Learning Model using Concept Drift Analysis: A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The need of efficiently working supervised machine learning models is of great importance and it is the domain of widespread research in the top Information Technology sector industry. Presently machine learning models are becoming very complex, and it is necessary to maintain the efficiency of the models in the increased complexity for better performance. Efficiency of the complex supervised machine learning models plays a significant role in the improved user experience, cost and resource optimization, real time applications, model interpretability, explainability and its reuse ability. Organizations are able to utilize the full capability of the supervised learning models and can have the expected outcome in the allied sector with efficient supervised machine leaning models. Machine learning is the part of the almost any industry and has its effect on many aspects of human life. To design the expected workable and efficient machine learning model is really challenging. It mainly includes the importance steps such as to select the proper data sets, accurate feature analysis, selecting the proper machine learning model type, architecture, hyper parameters finally designing efficient model. Concept drift is the major challenge in this design process and that needs to be analyzed with systematic approach. This review paper aims to discuss Concept drift analysis with respect to supervised machine learning models.

articleTitle: The Role of AI in Patients' Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Artificial intelligence plays a transformative role in healthcare patient communication. AI technologies enable patients to interact with healthcare providers in a seamless and personalized manner through NLP functionalities such as machine learning and natural language understanding. These AI-driven chatbots and virtual assistants facilitate real-time, convenient access to healthcare information, schedule appointments, and triage symptoms. These systems will be able to interpret questions from the patients and provide appropriate responses that are not only correct but also empathetic, raising levels of satisfaction and engagement. Furthermore, AI shapes the landscape of multilingual communication, eradicating language barriers to healthcare access for patients of various backgrounds. More advanced AI in the future can adapt to the patient’s needs and preferences with increased emotional intelligence and adaptive capabilities to ensure personalized interactions. The role of AI in patient communication continues to expand, working towards improved delivery of healthcare and patient outcomes through better access, responsiveness, and personalization of care.

articleTitle: Review Article: AI Tools for Detection of Cardiovascular Disorders
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: This paper also warns that cardiovascular diseases remain to be the primary leading causes of ailment and mortality in the world. Thus, only in the past few years, there were possibilities for creating, developing, and optimizing the zones for the early detection and identification of Due to this freshly emerged artificial intelligence (AI), the aforementioned subject gets affected by a number of diseases. The comparison of the virtues and the vices of the multiple tools and paradigms of the AI. the diagnosis of cardiovascular illnesses are opinions that are being conveyed in this paper. We also examine AI ideas in the clinical domain concerning the improvement of the heart health as well as the characteristics of its further development as a social institute.

articleTitle: The Role of Technology in Modern Education
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: It can be seen that technology has played a big role in today’s education through the use of smart boards and AI. Some of the advantages are that it affords students better access and opportunity for participation and brings more flexibility and efficiency to the teaching process and allows students to experience learning in new ways. However, there are also disadvantages such as digital divides, screen time, privacy concerns, and technical limitations. After highlighting the implications, the article analyses potential developments such as AI tutors and 5G connectivity as potential frontier technologies for the next era of learning technologies. Concisely, technology is an enhancement resource that should be embraced and complement quality teaching. The appropriate policy and continuous enhancement are the two crucial strategies for the education systems to implement technology to foster students with competencies required in the twenty-first century. Further research is needed regarding such matters as time spent in front of screens, media education, and implementation of new technologies in schools.

articleTitle: Precision Agriculture Technologies for crop monitoring and management
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: In India, agriculture is a significant industry that is both essential for presence and a critical financial support point. There is an extraordinary opportunity to settle farming creation issues with valuable and proficient arrangements because of machine learning (ML). The accuracy of current Agricultural precision technologies, such manual counting, environment brilliant bug control, and satellite photography, vary based on the precision method and inadequate. In this way, using advances like remote detecting, geographic information systems (GIS), global positioning systems (GPS), the Internet of Things (IoT), and so forth, researchers and specialists are attempting to upgrade agricultural result projections; in any case, the outcomes are not empowering. The fundamental objective of this method is to further develop agricultural creation forecast through the use of ML procedures. To accomplish high precision, the recommended framework utilizes ML models that have been prepared on authentic information utilizing support vector regression (SVR) and multi-layer perceptron’s (MLP) to achieve the high precision crop monitoring and management.

articleTitle: A Survey on Recognition and Translation System of Real-Time Sign Language
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Real-time sign language recognition systems are developed to improve access towards communication and enhance the accessibility of the communication pathway in the community of deaf and hard of hearing. This paper aims to provide a review of various methodologies that have been exploited to interpret such systems, with a focus on advanced deep learning techniques being implemented. The LSTM model applied towards understanding sign language gestures in real time where users can seamlessly communicate using a friendly interface, while capturing gestures through feeds from cameras demonstrates high accuracy in recognizing a vast range of gestures that show potential usage as assistive technology. More recently, CNNs have been extensively used in American Sign Language recognition, and promising results have been achieved with models such as GoogLeNet and YOLO. Relevant models to this paper utilize datasets with widespread lighting conditions and varied backgrounds, creating a more robust model. More recent work has included the YOLOv4-CSP algorithm that produces improved detection performance with optimized network architecture and data augmentation techniques. In addition, YOLO-v9 goes a significant step beyond others in terms of real-time sign language detection. In addition, it is faster in recognizing gestures and has much higher accuracy than any previous version. Such technologies make communication instantaneous but also empower hearingimpaired people by bringing them closer to others in society. Further studies and developments in this area may even lead to more refined solutions for solving sign language translation issues to increase appreciation towards each other.

articleTitle: An integrated analysis of AI networks and wireless communication (E-mail)
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into wireless communication networks represents a transformative shift in the telecommunications landscape. This analysis explores the synergistic relationship between AI networks and wireless communication, particularly in the context of emerging technologies like 5G and 6G. AI enhances various aspects of wireless networks, including network management, spectrum optimization, and security. By leveraging machine learning algorithms, operators can analyse vast amounts of data to predict network demand, optimize resource allocation, and automate maintenance processes. This capability is crucial as the number of connected devices is expected to exceed 30 billion by 2025, necessitating efficient management of network resources. The architecture of future wireless networks will likely incorporate multiple AI layers—intelligent sensing, data analytics, intelligent control, and smart applications—to facilitate real-time decision-making and resource management. These advancements not only improve operational efficiency but also enhance user experience by minimizing latency and increasing reliability. Moreover, AI's role in cybersecurity within wireless networks is becoming increasingly vital, as it can detect anomalies and respond to potential threats more swiftly than traditional methods. The convergence of AI and wireless communication is set to redefine how networks operate, ensuring they can meet the demands of an increasingly connected world while maintaining high performance and security standards. This integrated analysis underscores the importance of ongoing research and development in AI-enabled wireless technologies to harness their full potential for future applications. Furthermore, the collaboration between AI and wireless communication fosters innovations in Internet of Things (IoT) applications, smart cities, and autonomous.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Approaches to Financial Fraud Detection in Banks: A Research Perspective
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has changed the way we do business and is unquestionably a compelling aspect of the modern world. Every industry is impacted by technology, which is also vital to service delivery. Thanks to technological improvements, the banking and financial services sectors are able to leverage a variety of perspectives and resources that give them a competitive advantage in the fiercely competitive corporate world. The number of fraud cases has decreased thanks in large part to the use of AI-based products and services as Teradata, Feedzai, Riskified, Clari5, Razorpay Third Watch, AdvaRisk, Kount, and others. At the same time, the effectiveness and efficiency of business processes have increased.

articleTitle: Personalized Treatment Classification for Breast Cancer Patients using Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: In traditional treatments of breast cancer patients, people get the similar treatment that means it follows a "one-size-fits-all" approach. Over a while, doctors have noticed that some treatments have given better results for some people than others. Everyone has their own unique identifying features, and so the treatment to the individual patients also needs to be tailor made. Personalized medicine (PM) for breast cancer considers individual differences in people’s lifestyle, surroundings, and genetics, and it provides medicos with the information they need to target disease specific treatments. (ML)Machine learning plays an important role in personalized medicine (PM). It uses computational algorithms to analyze large amounts of data from different input sources such as medical records, molecular, genetic information, and data from clinical trials for finding patterns and predict outcomes. This information can then be used to tailor treatments specifically to an individual’s characteristics and assist doctor in finding risk of disease and finding optimal treatments. The paper discusses about application of supervised machine learning (ML)algorithm: Random Forest algorithms for classification of three treatments of breast cancer patients namely chemotherapy, hormonal therapy and amputation.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Approaches for Effective IoT Malware Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has gained significant attention as a research domain due to its wide-ranging applications. In this paper , we propose two deep learning models for IoT malware classification. Both models are evaluated through two experiments: the first experiment involves the utilization of chi-square feature selection, while the second experiment incorporates Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques without feature selection. Our proposed approaches for malware detection achieve a detection accuracy of 87% using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) with chi-square feature selection, 89% accuracy using Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) with chi-square feature selection, 96% accuracy using CNN with NLP techniques, and 99% accuracy using RNN with NLP techniques. Furthermore, the performance of the RNN model with NLP techniques is compared to recent advancements in the field, highlighting its superior effectiveness.

articleTitle: Blockchain in Pharmaceutical Supply chain Management
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Blockchain has tremendous power supply chain (SC) operations in order to change from, originating SC, re-engineering business operations to meliorate security. The ultimate objective of this article is to furnish crucial understanding of the association of blockchain in pharmaceutical supply chains (PSC) and furthermore develop a conceptual structure for application in the pharmaceutical industry. Blockchain technology is being widely use in supply chain management since it prevents the forfeiting of the drugs in the distribution chain. Mostly concentrating upon employing blockchain to deal with industry-specific problems such as patient privacy, regulation, and clinical research, as well as drug counterfeiting and recall challenges. We emphasize the corresponding advantages, potential social effects, and the most advanced technology available today as well as key trends and challenges. Blockchain-based technology can successfully improve healthcare by enhancing the visibility and management of operations.

articleTitle: Design of an Improved Model for Music Sequence Generation Using Conditional Variational Autoencoder and Conditional GAN
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Whilst the task of creating music sequences through artificial intelligence has been met with a lot of attention, current approaches tend to stumble when it comes to capturing rich structures and subtle detail in musical compositions. Conventional models lack the capacity to build temporal dependencies as well as incorporate condition mechanisms (such as genre or mood), counteracting in less-ideal generation quality. In this work we address the above limitations and propose a hybrid model incorporating Dynamic Conditional Variational Autoencoder (CVAE) [15] and Generative Adversarial Network for music sequence generation from MIDI files. Our proposed approach utilizes a piano-roll representation and an event-based encoding for pre-processing, retaining structural as well as temporal complexities of music samples at the level of events. Meanwhile, the CVAE part (in a Seq2Seq architecture) is introduced to model conditioned latent distribution over music sequence attributes such as genre or composer identity in order contribute both generation and reconstruction of realistic musical samples. Furthermore, a Conditional GAN (cGAN) along with Wasserstein GAN with Gradient Penalty (WGAN-GP) is utilized for generating sequences of better quality by creating more realistic and conditionally plausible music samples. The results we show demonstrate that this hybrid CVAE-GAN framework can not only significantly improve the quality of generated music sequences (in terms like FAD) but also allow for a better listening experience, outperforming state-of-the-art evaluation methods. The work sets up a potential future in which AI helps musicians compose more nuanced music that is almost indistinguishable from the product of human creativity.

articleTitle: Design of an Improved Model for IoV Security Using Bioinspired Optimization & Scalable Blockchains
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Urgent to the rising threat of attacks, such as Sybil, masquerading, and flooding attacks, whereby the integrity of the network and its performance become compromised severely, is the need for improved security and communication efficiency in IoV. This work would then propose a holistic approach integrating Blockchain-enhanced SDN and QoS slicing, bioinspired routing, machine learning-driven intrusion detection, fuzzy logic-based trust management, and deep reinforcement learning to address all these challenges in an integrated way. This proposed model utilizes Blockchain-based Secure Slicing with Smart Contracts to enhance authentication and resource management and provide a reduction of up to 30% latency along with 98% accuracy in preventing attacks. The application of ACO for routing enhancement reduces packet loss up to 10% in flooding attacks. A hybrid Intrusion Detection System integrating both machine learning and blockchain, with accuracy at 99.2% for Sybil, masquerading, and flooding attacks; Fuzzy logic-based trust management re-validates the routing by checking the trust scores at 95%; and the DRL-based mitigation system that dynamically adapts to new threats provides reduction in network downtime up to 35-40%. This multi-layered approach enhances security and performance for communication with which the IoV networks are to be resilient against evolving threats.

articleTitle: Throat Cancer Detection: A Comprehensive Review of Multimodal Analysis and Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Throat cancer is a disease state in which a malignant growth occurs at the pharynx, larynx, or tonsils. The current methods of diagnosis have much room for improvement. The traditional techniques are based strongly on invasive procedures and are highly handicapped by their subjectivity and the inherent intra- and interobserver variability in the clinical interpretation of the operations. This paper looks at existing models of advanced throat cancer detection using multimodal analysis coupled with machine- learning techniques. This review includes state-of-the-art techniques: Convolutional Neural Networks, Recurrent Neural Networks, and hybrid models combining CNNs and RNNs with other machine learning methods. By learning from multiple modes of collected information, such as medical imaging data, genome data, and records of patient health, the series of models created can be data-driven in the furthering of diagnostic accuracy. Key methodologies analyzed include CNN-Based Imaging Analysis, applied due to their capability to automatically extract and learn features from medical images, thus increasingly improving the precision of the diagnosis, together with a reduction of the involvement of manual intervention operations. RNNs for Temporal Data, which have applications to sequential data analysis of patient records, capturing temporal dependencies, all crucial elements in disease progression and understanding. In addition, this work further examines the possible ways transfer learning, as well as ensemble learning, can help boost model performance. This work's impact is rather significant in a way that it shows how multimodal analysis and machine learning can be pivotal in their role toward throat cancer detection. Improved capacities in reviewed models regarding early diagnosis, in turn, may improve earlier discovery of the patients and consequently survival rates, while minimization of treatment costs occurs.

Index Terms: Head And Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma

articleTitle: Advanced Hybrid Model: Multimodal Emotion Recognition with Improved EEG Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Emotion is a common occurrence in daily life as a subjectively psychological reaction to environmental stimuli. Emotion recognition via EEG data is quickly becoming a multidisciplinary research subject due to advances in artificial intelligence and brain science. This study compares several machine learning techniques, including Support Vector Machine (SVM), K-nearest neighbour, Linear Discriminant Analysis, Logistic Regression, and Decision Trees. Existing works achieves enhancement on separate/single analysis based models. Each of these models is tested both with and without principal component analysis (PCA) for reducing the dimensionality. This work achieves sustainable computing on all models. Moreover, the epoch data from EEG sensor channels is analysed. This work analysed that in the 30th to 45th segmentation interval, PCA with SVM performed the best, yielding an F1-score of 84.73% with 98.01% recall. This paper summarises current advances and identifies important directions for future study, making it a useful resource for scholars and practitioners in the domains of machine learning and EEG analysis.

articleTitle: The Problem Of Data Bias In Healthcare AI
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Bias in data collection for machine learning entails complexity in the fairness of the forecast and the efficiency of the model. This occurs especially when data is biased, gathered from unrepresentative samples, or experiences systematic errors in data gathering; the consequences of such data include unfair policies and practices that perpetuate inequity in society. This abstract focuses on how biases affect machine learning algorithms and how the biases work to arise and spread. It describes methods of how to avoid the bias problem in data, how to build sets that are as diverse as possible and properly preprocess the data, and such things as algorithmic fairness metrics. Tackling biases in data is a close-to- impossible task that can help ensure fairness in equal and right machine learning.

articleTitle: IoT-based Smart Solution for Furrow Farming
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: This paper presents the development and implementation of an advanced irrigation system integrating soil moisture sensors and solenoid valves to create a flexible and efficient irrigation framework. The system is designed to detect and respond to specific moisture thresholds in each furrow, ensuring optimal water distribution. When the sensors detect adequate moisture levels, the solenoid valves are deactivated, and the irrigation system shuts down sequentially to prevent water wastage. With farm-wide connectivity, users can remotely monitor, update, and activate the system as needed, allowing for precise control and customization based on varying farm sizes and water requirements. This automated irrigation system promotes sustainable farming practices by optimizing crop growth through precise water management, minimizing wastage, and enhancing overall productivity. This innovative solution empowers farmers with real-time control by bridging the gap between technology and agriculture, leading to more efficient and productive farming operations.

articleTitle: Fine-tuned Transfer Learning Models for Multi-class Classification of Melanoma Skin Cancer
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Melanoma skin cancer is the deadliest disease that needs detection and treatment at early stages. Systems have been proposed in the literature for melanoma skin cancer detection with its types through standard Machine learning & Deep learning mechanisms. These models still need enhancement to improve the detection rate and reduce the false positives to avoid future losses or problems related to the skin. Transfer learning helps use the existing pre-trained weights on a specific task for other use cases. The transfer learning layers can be retrained by keeping some with the same weights and changing others. This study proposes a new approach to improve melanoma class identification, leveraging the strengths of transfer learning models to improve diagnostic precision. Our methodology involves optimizing four proposed CNN architectures - VGG-16, ResNet-50, Inception V3 & VGG-19 to extract relevant features from dermatological images. We maximize feature extraction and classification outcomes by strategically selecting and fine-tuning convolutional layers. Our evaluation of a comprehensive dataset of melanoma images reveals improved results, surpassing existing methods by a notable margin. The primary aim is to compare different network performances of the pre-trained and fine-tuned networks to enable the selection of the best model for melanoma classification. Standard performance metrics are used to compare the results of the fine-tuned architectures proposed in the paper. ResNet-50 yields the highest accuracy of 98% for multi-class classification, and other fine-tuned architectures have also shown satisfactory performance.

articleTitle: How IFP, Interactive Tabs, and AI Affect the Achievement in Rural East Godavari District Secondary Schools–A Study
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The function of the study is to determine the role of interactive flat panels (IFPs), interactive tabs, and artificial intelligence (AI) in improving students' learning. In light of the United Nation's (UN's) Sustainable Development Goals (SDG), National Educational Policy (NEP) 2020, and as a part of Digitalizing the Education System, tabs with interactive online and offline content with internet access at school are given to the students by the government of Andhra Pradesh for quality learning. Every classroom has an interactive flat panel and an internet facility. This study qualitatively observed the quantitative improvements in students' academic achievements and attitudes toward the interactive screens. The study found a significant change in the students' achievements. The students expressed their positive attitude and optimism towards benefiting from their interactive devices with interactive content. The study inherently studied the role of AI and ruling electronic gadgets in achieving learning outcomes. The study also considered teachers' attitudes toward technology and AI integration to make learning effective and constructive.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study of Water Quality Trends and Seasonal Variations in Coastal Bays
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Monitoring and analysing water quality parameters is fundamental for the early detection of natural changes in coastal bays. This paper examines regular varieties and relationships among key water quality parameters—salinity, broken up oxygen, pH, Secchi profundity, water profundity, and water temperature—collected from a coastal bay over a period in 1994. Information preprocessing included changing over dates to a standardized arrange and guaranteeing numerical consistency over parameters. Exploratory data analysis (EDA) given experiences into the temporal patterns of individual parameters. Consequent relationship examination revealed significant interdependencies among the parameters, highlighting potential impacts of seasonal and environmental components. The paper moreover reviewed monthly midpoints to recognize regular designs. Line plots laid out the varieties in saltiness, broken up oxygen, pH, and water temperature over differing months, emphasizing the cyclic nature of these parameters. Comes about appear unmistakable regular designs, such as higher broken down oxygen levels amid colder months and assortments in saltiness comparing to potential freshwater convergences. These revelations emphasize the centrality of nonstop water quality watching to induce it the energetic natural forms impacting coastal ecosystems. This investigate contributes to natural administration methods by giving a comprehensive examination of water quality variances, helping inside the definition of approaches for the conservation and economical administration of coastal bay regions.

articleTitle: The Role of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Transforming Biomedical Imaging: A Comprehensive Overview
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in biomedical imaging heralds a transformative era in medical diagnostics and research. This comprehensive overview explores the multifaceted impact of AI on various imaging modalities, emphasizing its potential to revolutionize disease detection, characterization, and treatment planning. AI applications, particularly machine learning and deep learning, enhance the analysis of intricate imaging data, providing quicker and more accurate insights. This review delves into AI's role in automating diagnosis through the development of sophisticated algorithms, enabling faster and more precise identification of diseases across diverse medical imaging platforms. Furthermore, AI contributes to improving image quality, facilitating early detection of abnormalities, and enhancing decision support systems for clinicians. Beyond diagnosis, AI facilitates personalized medicine by tailoring treatment strategies based on individual patient data extracted from imaging. The ethical considerations and privacy implications of handling sensitive medical information are also discussed, ensuring a balanced perspective on the adoption of AI in healthcare. As AI continues to advance, this overview concludes with insights into future trends, challenges, and the collaborative synergy between technology, healthcare practitioners, and researchers, underscoring the ongoing evolution of biomedical imaging through artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: Surgical Robotics in Ophthalmology
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Surgical robotics in ophthalmology has seen rapid advancements, enhancing precision, safety, and efficiency. This review explores integrating robotic systems in various ophthalmic procedures, including retinal, cataract, refractive, corneal, and glaucoma surgeries. Key robotic technologies include smart sensors, telemanipulation, and comanipulation, each contributing to improved outcomes and reduced recovery time. Future developments aim for increased automation and autonomous capabilities, potentially transforming surgical practice.

articleTitle: Prospective Elementary Teachers’ Computational Thinking Skills: A Preliminary Study
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Computational thinking refers to thinking and solving issues in the same way as computer scientists do. This study aims to evaluate the computational thinking skills of prospective elementary teachers. This study uses a quantitative descriptive research method. The research instrument uses a computational thinking skills test containing four indicators, namely decomposition, algorithm, pattern recognition, abstraction/generalization. The subjects of this study were 244 prospective elementary teachers from a Study Program of Elementary School Teacher Education at a public university in Pekanbaru, Riau, Indonesia. The results of this study indicate that the computational thinking skills of prospective elementary teachers are in the moderate category. Among the four indicators, prospective elementary teachers’ skills of decomposition and pattern recognition are higher than algorithm and abstraction/generalization.

articleTitle: Web-Based Smart Healthcare System
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: In today’s healthcare sector, utilizing information technology is essential for improving hospital operations. This study presents the creation and deployment of a web-based Smart Healthcare system (SHS) aimed at optimizing various administrative and clinical tasks within a healthcare setting. Some of the components are patient portal for signing in, practice calendar, assessment tools, invoicing, and reporting using webbased platform. Web based technologies and keeping a centralized database leads to secure data management, real time information and effective communication between different departments. This paper focuses on the description of the system’s layout, structure and basic operations identifying it as a tool for raising organizational productivity, improving data accuracy and promoting patient care benefits.

articleTitle: The Future of Learning: AI-guided Content Creation and Automated Delivery Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: From medical diagnosis to communication, AI has changed the way human brain think and work about different things making life easier for human beings. This research paper shows the application of AI in creating and delivering content, how it personalizes learning materials or adapts them to a specific user experience, interactive contents automation and so on. With AI, educators can design and offer more meaningful learning experiences that better meet the specific needs of each student. The paper also focused on the ethical considerations and challenges which are associated with AI in education so that the tools which are used for AI can be used effectively that will enhance the learning experience for all the students. This paper highlights the potential use of AI in education that includes adaptive learning which adjusts according to students’ requirements, their intelligence to have personalized guidance, and study material suggested from the relevant resources.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Evaluation Process by Analytical Hierarchical Process for Identification of Potential Groundwater Zones
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: For social and economic development of any region, groundwater plays a very vital role. Surface water infiltration depends on various parameters of the earth. The parameters includes Slope, Geology, Soil Type, Land Use/Land Cover, Rainfall, Drainage Density based on the study area under consideration. There exists various techniques for recognizing of groundwater probable regions. This paper focuses specifically on the recognizing of the subsurface water probable regions by Analytical Hierarchy Process. The steps involved in the process are discussed in detailed and shows how the potential zone identification is based on value of weights evaluated.

articleTitle: Blockchain Enabled Secure Data Sharing in Medical Sensors Networks: Concise Review
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Medical sensor networks have transformed patient monitoring and treatment approaches in the ever-changing healthcare industry. However, strong systems for safe and effective data sharing are necessary to fully use sensor data. Conventional methods of exchanging data in healthcare are frequently rife with security flaws, such as the potential for data tampering and privacy violations. Blockchain technology offers decentralized, irreversible, and transparent data sharing and storage capabilities and offers a promising solution to these problems. The potential for safe data sharing offered by Blockchain technology to revolutionize healthcare delivery is examined in this review paper, which examines the convergence of medical sensor networks and Blockchain technology. This paper explores the various Blockchain implementation architectures, approaches, and case studies in healthcare contexts by thoroughly examining current literature. This paper also discusses the prospects, difficulties, and future directions in this emerging subject, emphasizing the effects on interoperability, patient care, and data security. By explaining the revolutionary possibilities of secure data sharing in medical sensor networks afforded by Blockchain technology, the current study hopes to stimulate additional investigation and creativity in the quest for safer and more effective healthcare systems.

articleTitle: A Review: Citrus Disease Detection Using Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Citrus is an important fruit crops worldwide, and diseases are one of the major constraints affecting their production and quality. An early stage detection and precise classification of citrus diseases are very important for the disease management, effectively. Diseases can affect Leaves, Fruits and stem of citrus plant. Traditional methods for disease detection and classification are time-consuming and expensive. Various techniques are proposed for the classification and detection of citrus crop diseases. Use of Machine Learning algorithms like SVM, ANN, Fuzzy C-Means Classifier, KNN, and CNN classifier are proposed by many researchers worldwide after the investigation and validation of results. This work includes the study of various citrus crop diseases and the review of literature on automatic detection and identification of the diseases using machine learning and Deep learning approaches. It also includes the brief overview of the techniques in order to improve the detection accuracy using Data Augmentation and Transfer Learning.

articleTitle: AI in Gaming: From Simple Algorithms to Complex Agents
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: In it, they contended that with the rise of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the gaming field, the later has become more than mere algorithms. This review categorizes the milestones in the development of AI from basic algorithms and moving up to the current movement of machine learning and neural networks where AI agents can learn, reason on their own, and respond to the actions of the player. In this paper, seminal points in gaming history, technology progress, and essential Artificial Intelligence technologies constituting modern gaming are described. It combines the possible ethical issues related to Artificial Intelligence applications in the gaming industry. Measuring experiences and competitions that are thrilling and exciting but still fair. By outlining the current state and future possibility of Artificial Intelligence, this article explains how it has brought the change in gaming and has made it more real.

articleTitle: Design of an Improved Model Using Hyperspectral Imaging, Data Fusion, and Transformer-Based Deep Learning for Crop Disease Identification Operations
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Accurate and timely diagnosis of crop diseases is crucial for food security and agricultural sustainability. Current methods lack accuracy, interpretability, data integration, and advanced imaging techniques. The current research aims to address such issues by proposing a broad-perspective approach that brings into play hyperspectral imaging in tandem with 3D reconstruction, multimodal data integration, advanced machine learning models, and finally, trickled-down with XAI techniques. Up to now, approaches in the detection of crop diseases have been basically dependent on RGB imaging information and single-information sources that are incapable of accounting for interactions amidst the variety of factors affecting crop health. These methods have poor spatial and spectral analysis; thus, leading to limited accuracy and also offering little elucidation on the implication of the models. Overcoming these limitations, we employed a hyperspectral imaging approach with the 3D reconstruction for achieving fine spectral and spatial quantification of the crops. Through this approach, accuracy in disease detection was improved from 85% to 92%, and this approach drives a holistic view of the crops. Through data fusion, hyperspectral images, soil health parameters, and weather data were integrated. Their integration significantly improved the predictive accuracy—all the way up to 89% from 78% overall accuracy. We also developed an explainable Transformer-based deep learning model with in-built attention mechanisms and Grad-CAM for explainability. Such an advanced model architecture allowed draft feature extraction and provided visual explanations on the decisions made by the model, increasing classification accuracy from 88% to 94% and interpretability by 70%. A combination of hyperspectral imaging, data fusion, and advanced machine learning with XAI improves the model's accuracy and its robustness and therefore improves the latter's transparency in the decision-making process.

articleTitle: Improved Healthcare Quality through Health Informatics
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: This study article explores the association between health reporting and increased health care quality. The process of obtaining, assessing, and managing health information involves applying medical concepts to IT procedures. The term "health care process improvement" describes methodical, ongoing efforts that result in better feasibility assessment in the delivery of healthcare and the state of certain patient populations' health. The essay addresses issues, worries, and developments in the field of health journalism in addition to how improvements in the quality of healthcare are connected to it. Electronic health records (EHRs), which are computerized recordings of a patient's medical history, are also discussed in the article. EHRs can improve patient information access, treatment efficiency, and care efficiency. But EHRs also have drawbacks, such as limited sensitivity in diagnostic codes and insufficient accounting for non-EHR symptoms that can effect changes in quality of care Narrative Importance requirement for better documentation accuracy, easy access to patient information, clinical decision support systems, medication reduction errors, integrated clinical guidelines, and health information exchange s does overall article in patient outcomes It also emphasizes the necessity of increasing the quality of health care and the provision of health information to improve health care.

articleTitle: AI Vigilance: Pioneering Malware Detection In The Android Realm
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: provides a different strategy for preventing malware from harming Android devices. By improving accuracy and speed, the research seeks to transform malware detection through the use of modern artificial intelligence (AI) approaches. Real-time monitoring systems, prediction models for finding complex malware behaviour patterns, and AI-driven feature extraction techniques are important elements. The research aims to determine the efficacy and dependability of its AI-based malware detection system through thorough testing and validation with various datasets. The focus is on smooth integration, performance optimisation, and scalability within the current Android security framework. The research findings have considerable potential to improve mobile security by providing preventive measures against new malware attacks.“AI Vigilance” is an innovative attempt aimed at establishing a more secure and robust Android computing environment in the face of constantly changing cybersecurity threats.

articleTitle: Integrating Quantitative Parameters for Automating Medical Equipment Maintenance Using Industry 4.0 and FMEA
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: In the progression of Industry 4.0, the incorporation of cutting-edge technologies such as big data analytics, machine learning, and automation has revolutionized conventional maintenance methods across various industries, including healthcare. This study examines the impact of linking quantitative metrics with the advancement of Industry 4.0 applications, utilizing Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) as a foundational methodology. The research aims to establish a comprehensive maintenance framework for medical equipment, emphasizing how FMEA's systematic approach to identifying and prioritizing potential failures can be enhanced through Industry 4.0 tools. By using quantitative data—such as failure rates (FR), mean time to repair (MTTR), and Risk Priority Numbers (RPN)—the study illustrates how predictive maintenance strategies can be refined, resulting in significant improvements in equipment reliability and operational efficiency. The incorporation of real-time monitoring and automated decision-making within the proposed framework not only reduces equipment downtime but also ensures the continuity of essential healthcare services, especially in critical environments. This study highlights the importance of quantitative analysis in developing and validating Industry 4.0 applications, offering insights into how these technologies can optimize maintenance practices and ultimately enhance patient outcomes in the healthcare field.

articleTitle: Integrating Transparent Crowdfunding Platform and AI-Based Treatment Fund Estimation
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Blockchain technology, first introduced in 2008, emerged as a solution to establish trust for confidential online transactions, particularly between donors and non-profit organizations. With the acceptance of digital currencies, charities can now reach new groups of donors. Fundraising platforms that support international donations are convenient for finding charities to support. Blockchain technology allows for transparent and secure tracking of donated funds, ensuring they reach their intended destination without intermediaries. This enhances donor protection against fraud and provides transparency. Additionally, AI is used in predicting the hospital that has a lesser amount than the patient requested and rises only a certain amount to the patient's need for the operation by analyzing data and identifying potential donors, ensuring data accuracy and integrity.

articleTitle: Design of an Improved Model for Nutrient Deficiency Detection in Plants Using CNNs, Autoencoders, and Precision-Aware Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: This paper presents a new machine learning-based approach for nutrient deficiency detection through literature shortcomings in advanced feature extractions and classification models. In the proposed framework, Convolutional Neural Networks are used for high-dimensional feature extraction from images and samples of plants. Only in that case will such architectures of CNNs, through their convolutional operations, pooling layers, and feature maps, be able to capture relevant indicators of color anomalies, texture, shape, or structure. Pre-trained models have been fine-tuned for VGG16, ResNet, and Inception in plant-specific data for better accuracy in feature identification. This work is based on auto-encoders, a type of unsupervised learning for feature extraction from images of plants; through encoder-decoder architecture with a bottleneck layer, only important features are maintained. Principal Component Analysis further reduces the dimensionality of the feature space by isolating key components that contribute to the data variance through eigenvectors and eigenvalues in real-time use case scenarios. Classifications are done using Support Vector Machines against high accuracy and robustness using Kernel functions like Radial Basis Function in the transformation of the feature space. Random Forests add to the feature importance and avoid overfitting by combining many self-same decision trees. It uses GBMs because of their sequential error-correcting nature, and the quality of the predictions is improved due to boosting iterations across different scenarios. Cost-sensitive learning with focal loss and other precision-aware methods are implemented to handle class imbalance and increase model sensitivity to critical misclassifications. This is an integral methodology for raising the correctness and efficiency of nutrient deficiency detection and providing a scalable and robust solution for modern agricultural practices.

articleTitle: Exploring Medical Diagnosis Using Vision Transformer And CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: This research aims to conduct a comparative analysis of Vision Transformer (ViT) and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) models for detecting four prevalent diseases: eye diseases, lung diseases, skin diseases, and heart diseases. The primary goal is to identify the most suitable and efficient model for each disease, taking into account their unique characteristics and diagnostic requirements. Through a meticulous evaluation and comparison of the performance of various ViT and CNN models for each illness, this study endeavors to offer valuable insights into the optimal utilization of these advanced technologies in disease detection. The comprehensive analysis presented in this paper is intended to contribute to the progress of medical imaging and potentially enhance diagnostic precision and efficacy in healthcare.

articleTitle: The Impact of AI-Driven Personalization on Customer Loyalty: A Meta-Analysis of E-commerce Studies
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) has changed the way e-commerce works by making it possible to provide unique experiences to a huge number of customers. This review looks at how AI-driven personalization affects customer trust in a number of different e-commerce studies. Putting together the results of several research papers, this study gives a full picture of how well AI works and what it means for increasing customer trust in online stores. The studies were chosen because they had something to do with how AI-driven customizing changes customer behavior and trust measures. The results show that there is a strong link between AI-driven customization and customer trust in online shopping. Personalized suggestions based on AI algorithms were shown in multiple studies to make customers happier, get them to buy from you again, and build long-term ties with them. AI-powered customization of user interfaces and content delivery made the experiences of users better, which increased interest and decreased return rates. The meta-analysis also found a number of factors that affect how well AI-driven personalization works.

articleTitle: Efficient Model for Social Behaviour Analysis and Depression Detection in User Tweets
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Knowing the way individuals engage on social networking platforms has become important in the modern era. The current research discusses the urgent need for advanced methods for analyzing tweets from users In order to analyze social behavior, particularly when it comes to the recognition of sadness. Though sentiment evaluation has advanced, current techniques frequently disregard crucial variables like user age, tweet time, and emotion of users-linked data. precisely a consequence, there remains a shortage in the understanding needs to correctly assess depression-related behaviors based upon social networking content. We offer a novel architecture that combines fuzzy logic constraint algorithms, graph neural network models (GNNs), with the VADER sentiment detection in order to bridge this gap. Our approach takes into account contextual variables including the age of the individual and the date and time of the post so as to determine the mood of the user's tweets via VADER sentiment evaluation. likewise, our team apply GNNs for further sentiment analysis to linked information, allowing for greater understanding of the feelings of users. When integrating these inputs, the fuzzy logic rule generator provides the user with an anxiety class, delivering the detailed viewpoint upon mental wellness assessments. With the incorporation combined specific to users’ characteristics including sentiment assessment of linked data, our model arrives at enhanced accuracy in predicting overall anxiety. furthermore, the incorporation of fuzzy logic improves accessibility as well as flexibility in response to many different user inputs. This work provides significant possibilities regarding specific networks of support as well as mental wellness measures, in addition to developing the area of psychological analysis. In simple terms, the research we performed presents a comprehensive strategy for understanding and fixing emotional wellness problems in today's technological world.

articleTitle: Towards Seamless Glucose Monitoring: A Smart Non-Invasive System for Diabetes Patients
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Blood Glucose Monitoring levels are essential to the treatment of diabetes and must be done continuously. Patients often don't comply with conventional glucose monitoring techniques since they cause discomfort and are invasive. An Arduino microcontroller and infrared (I.R.) sensor are used in this work to provide a robust, non-invasive glucose monitoring system. I.R. light is transmitted through the skin to measure the quantity of light reflected, and this relationship exists between the amount of light and the amount of glucose in the interstitial fluid. In real-time, the Arduino analyses blood glucose levels by analyzing IR Spectroscopy and using machine learning techniques. The device features wireless connectivity, enabling it to send glucose readings to a mobile application for continuous monitoring, historical data analysis, and customized alerts. Initial trials indicate that this non-invasive system provides accurate glucose measurements comparable to traditional methods, significantly improving user comfort and compliance. This innovative approach promises a pain-free, user-friendly, and cost-effective solution for diabetes management, paving the way for more widespread adoption of continuous glucose monitoring.

articleTitle: Explainable AI for Fraud Detection: Enhancing Transparency and Trust in Financial Decision-Making
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
