articleTitle: Building a Data Lake for Power BI in the Cloud: A Review on Utilizing Cloud Storage Services for Large Datasets
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: A data lake is a centralized repository where you may store both structured and unstructured data at any scale. Unlike typical data warehouses, which need data structure for storage, data lakes allow you to store raw data in its natural state. This adaptability makes data lakes suitable for storing large volumes of various data kinds, including photographs, videos, log files, sensor data, and others. When integrating a data lake with Power Business Intelligence (BI), organizations can harness the power of both technologies to gain valuable insights from their data. In the realm of data-driven decision-making, organizations face the challenge of managing and extracting insights from vast and diverse datasets, a task conventional on-premises storage solutions often struggle with due to the exponential growth of data. Thus, the adoption of more scalable and flexible alternatives becomes imperative. Cloud-based data lakes emerge as transformative solutions, offering unparalleled scalability, accessibility, cost-effectiveness, and advanced security protocols. This paper discuss the concept of constructing a cloud-based data lake optimized for Power BI, leveraging leading cloud storage services like Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS) and Amazon S3. By seamlessly integrating Power BI with the cloud data lake, organizations can overcome traditional storage limitations and reap numerous benefits. The practical applications in advanced analytics, customer insights, IoT data management, and data discovery underscore the real-world utility of cloud data lakes. The integration of Power BI with a cloud data lake augments efficient data analysis and self-service analytics potential, offering organizations a comprehensive solution for deriving actionable insights from their data assets.

articleTitle: Developing an Edge based predictive maintenance system for transformer using low-cost sensors
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Transformers are essential for ensuring the reliable distribution and transmission of electrical power. Traditional maintenance procedures, which are generally reactive and schedule-driven, can result in costly breakdowns and unanticipated expenses. This research offers an edge-based predictive maintenance system for transformers that uses powerful machine learning techniques and five temperature sensors strategically distributed throughout the transformer in non-invasive manner. The system uses edge computing to handle real-time temperature data locally, allowing for more precise and accurate anomaly detection and predictive analytics. This strategy enables proactive maintenance, timely interventions, and less operational disturbances. The proposed methodology optimises maintenance schedules, lowers downtime, and increases grid reliability, providing a viable method for managing essential infrastructure and improving overall grid dependability.

articleTitle: Detection of Objects in Remotely Sensed Images using an Explainable Convolutional Neural Network Enhanced with Tetralet Attention Optimized by Canis Hunt
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Object or Target identification has perennially represented a focal point of investigation within the realm of computer vision; particularly the task of detection in satellite imagery has emerged as a persistently intricate research domain. Despite various traditional studies attempting to address this issue, they have encountered limitations when handling high-resolution satellite images. The present study introduces a novel approach to object detection, referred to as the CHunt-TetraExNN. The primary objective of this proposed model is to achieve precise object detection utilizing airborne image inputs. The Tetralet attention mechanism integrated into the system consists of a triad of attention components paired with positional attention, facilitating the precise delineation of attention-based attributes crucial for object detection tasks Furthermore, the investigative framework utilizes the Canis Hunt Optimization method, combining the adaptable characteristics and predatory behaviors of Lapins and Latrans species from the Canis Family. As a result, the framework provides precise estimation results in the field of object identification in airborne images, demonstrating an Accuracy rate of 96.48%, Precision of 94.60%, Recall of 96.52%, and an F1 score of 95.60%.

articleTitle: Impact of AI Based Marketing on Performance of Two-Wheeler Business with special reference to Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The electric vehicle (EV) industry is being transformed by artificial intelligence (AI), which improves competence, security, and user experience through various inventions. These include AI-driven personalized interfaces, predictive maintenance, energy management, autonomous driving and intelligent charging systems. Moreover Artificial Intelligence is also converting the motorbike industry with valuations based on annual sales data while it can be used in marketing approaches using FullStory, Zapier, Chatfuel,(link unavailable), Influencity e.t.c leading to optimized and data driven marketing methods.

articleTitle: Heart Disease Prediction Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The heart plays a pivotal role in the functioning of living organisms, making its diagnosis and prediction of related diseases a matter of utmost importance. Approximately 17.9 million individuals succumb to cardiovascular disease, accounting for 32% of worldwide fatalities. This global concern highlights the importance of early detection, as timely treatment can significantly reduce heart disease-related mortality. Errors in diagnosis can lead to severe consequences, including fatigue or even death. The increasing prevalence of heart-related diseases necessitates the development of precise prediction systems to enhance awareness. Machine learning, a subset of Artificial Intelligence (AI), offers robust tools for predicting various events based on patterns learned from natural occurrences. This research paper evaluates the accuracy of machine learning algorithms, specifically k- nearest neighbor, decision tree, linear regression, and support vector machine (SVM), in predicting heart disease. We utilize the UCI repository dataset for training and testing and employ the Python programming language through the Anaconda Jupyter notebook for implementation and the experimental findings indicate an accuracy rate of 95.7% using the heart disease prediction model, leveraging its extensive libraries and header files to ensure accuracy and precision in our analysis.

articleTitle: Analyzing Healthiness of Fast Food Items Using statistics and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive approach to evaluating the healthiness of fast food items through the integration of statistical analysis and machine learning techniques. By utilizing a dataset containing detailed nutritional information from multiple fast food chains, a custom health scoring algorithm is developed to assess and compare the nutritional quality of individual food items. Key health indicators such as calories, fat content, sugar, protein, and dietary fiber are analyzed to compute a standardized health score. In addition, a cancer risk model is implemented to estimate potential health risks associated with the consumption of specific items, emphasizing the importance of dietary choices in mitigating cancer risk. The use of machine learning techniques enhances the predictive capability of the model, allowing for the identification of patterns and trends across different restaurant chains. The proposed methodology offers valuable insights for consumers seeking healthier fast food options and provides a data-driven foundation for public health initiatives aimed at improving dietary habits. The findings demonstrate the significant nutritional variation among fast food items and highlight the potential for machine learning to contribute to nutrition-based public health research.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Approach To Healthcare Chatbots Using SpaCy NLP And Naive Bayes Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Imagine a world where medical assistance is just a conversation away, where artificial intelligence helps navigate your health concerns with precision, by the intersection of machine learning and healthcare, our chatbot emerges as a powerful ally for patients everywhere. This research work focuses on developing a healthcare chatbot which provides diagnosis of patients by taking user-input symptoms, suggesting medications and also hospitals in a particular region. Both speech and text options are introduced to interact with the user. Firstly, the user is prompted to enter the symptoms faced by them, the symptoms are extracted from user input sentences using SpaCy NLP. These extracted symptoms are fed to a Multinomial Naïve Bayes Classifier for disease prediction. Additionally, chatbot also provides the required medications and the hospitals in the region from the data stored in the CSV and PDF files. The user interface of the chatbot is built using Flask. SQL is leveraged for user account management and to store the diagnosis history of the user. The dataset used for training is a CSV file consisting of 132 unique symptoms, 42 unique diseases and a total of 4,920 combinations of symptoms and associated diseases. The dataset is pre-processed in the form of 1s and 0s to make it suitable for our Multinomial Naive Bayes model which achieved a test accuracy of 95% which is better than the existing models having an accuracy of around 93%.

articleTitle: A Review of Machine Learning and Deep Learning algorithms for Chronic Kidney Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) is a common disease worldwide that is manifested by slow progressive loss of kidney function that can result in complications and kidney failure. That is why conventional approaches to CKD diagnosis and treatment have certain difficulties: late identification of the disease, inaccuracy of the diagnosis, and high costs for the therapy. The new approaches for solving these problems are opened with the help of Machine Learning (ML) and deep learning (DL). These technologies can help existing information sets in large volumes in diagnosing, predicting, and in early detection of diseases to enhance the well-being of the patients. However, the outcome comes with a handful of constraints, including the quality of the data used in developing the models, the ability to interpret results from the generated model, and the complexity of the computation process. The following section describes the various ML and DL algorithms used for CKD, their strengths, weaknesses, and the possibility of implementing these technologies in clinical settings for better CKD outcomes.

articleTitle: AI in Healthcare – Precision Medicine and Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: By knowing the early risk factors prediction of disease through precision medicine has enhanced medical care surpassed the conventional symptom-driven treatment approach. To choose the best course for precision medicine, it is requisite to carefully consider both broad and overall patient data, the required posology data of patient; in case to understand the patient history to differentiate between sick and reasonably healthy individuals. This will enhance our comprehension of the molecular markers that can signify alterations in health. Artificial intelligence, precision, and genetic medicine leads to the better patient care. Genomic medicine technologies are being used by patients who have distinct healthcare needs or less typical therapeutic responses. Through sophisticated computing and inference, artificial intelligence (AI) offers insights that improve medical decision-making by allowing the system to think and learn. This in-depth study examines the relationship between artificial intelligence (AI) and healthcare, with a particular emphasis on the revolutionary potential of AI-driven personalized treatment regimens in the field of precision medicine. The essay emphasizes its significant influence on healthcare across multiple sectors and places a focus on responsible growth for the common good. In order to ensure a full investigation of the topic, the research method entails a detailed examination of AI in healthcare through indexed databases. The story explores how AI is transforming treatment planning, diagnosis, and patient care, especially in fields like radiation. When treating patients with metastatic cutaneous melanoma, standard medical imaging methods including CT, MRI, and PET are essential. Through the improvement of customized image-guided precision medicine strategies, advances in artificial intelligence (AI) techniques like radiomics, machine learning, and deep learning have the potential to completely transform the use of medical imaging. In this article, we will analyze how AI/radiomics might be used to mine data from medical pictures, including tumor volume, heterogeneity, and shape, to give doctors insights into cancer biology and enhance patient care in the clinic and during clinical trials. Artificial intelligence (AI) holds promise for improving many aspects of treating metastatic cutaneous melanoma, such as diagnosis, planning, delivery, response assessment, toxicity assessment, and patient monitoring.

articleTitle: Predictive Maintenance Strategies for Knee Implants: A MATLAB-Based Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Regarding knee implants, as critical medical products that have a significant impact on patients’ quality of life and mobility, dependable and durable are words that every producer of such implants has to take to heart, thus making predictive maintenance mandatory. The approach presented in this article prescribes the utilization of MATLAB in developing a predict-and-control- schedule for knee implants. The method simply includes the monitoring of critical parameters like wear and tear tension and corrosion in the context of hospitals. The goal of this methodology is to create classifier models in MATLAB which can predict a variety of possible future failures or deviations from exemplary performance leading to beneficial shifts in patient wellbeing, decreased rates of emergent maintenance needs and times, and the most efficient maintenance schedules. In this regard, the study reveals how effective MATLAB can be in relating real-time data of the sensors to the predicted maintenance requirements for the improvement of the reliability of the implant, besides increasing the useful life of the knee implants.

articleTitle: Development of a Nail-based Application for the Detection of Disease using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Disease diagnosis using non-invasive techniques is a key determinant in the improvement of outcomes in patients and the enhancement of precautionary health measures. The study focuses on the design and development of a nail-based detection application employing image processing techniques to detect diseases such as systemic disease, fungal disease, Leukonychia (White spots on nails) and Paronychia (Nail bed infection) through analysis of the patterns of the fingernails and other related symptoms. The developed system integrates several techniques, comprising a customized imaging application, a user-friendly interface, and software for real-time image processing and disease classification. A variety of algorithms proposed for image processing, such as Median filtering, Sobel Mask and HOG features, are designed to extract important features from nail images and then use machine learning models that match these features against a database of established markers of various diseases. Comprehensive testing utilizing an annotated dataset of nail images demonstrated the system’s accuracy in classifying certain diseases, further showcasing its potential for possible usage as a proficient tool for early disease diagnosis. Thus, this application is easy to use, user-friendly interface, and provides advancements in diagnosing diseases both in clinical settings and in the comfort of one’s home. The incorporation of this technology into routine clinical practice might facilitate the possibility of early diagnosis and early intervention, which could improve patient outcomes and reduce healthcare system burdens.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Models for Water Quality Assessment and Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Water is very crucial for every living being and utilizing of qualified water is much important. The solvent of water can have several components of polarity. Due to these compounds presented in water may be sometimes flavorless and unseen may leads to health problems for living beings. To reduce these risks much and should inspect the quality of a water. WQI (Water Quality Index) is hypothesis which gives discrete representation of standards of water at specific location. After applying WQI, if it fails to reach the standards, will take necessary actions before usage of non-standard water. In this study appraise of some machine learning strategies for assessing which includes Naïve Bayes, Random Forest, Decision Tree, AdaBoost, Logistic Regression, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Support Vector Machine (SVM). The demographic data was gathered from publicly available kaggle repository with 21K samples. Performed comparison analysis among above algorithms, random forest out performances with 91 % accuracy and also provided which feature having the high importance useful for forecasting excellence of water.

articleTitle: Enhancing Vector based Retrieval Augmented Generation with Contextual Knowledge Graph Construction
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The proliferation of unstructured text data necessitates efficient information retrieval systems. Traditional vector-based Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) models often fail to capture complex relationships and contextual nuances, limiting effectiveness in knowledge-intensive tasks. We introduce Contextual Knowledge Graph Construction (CKGC), a novel approach enhancing vector-based RAG by dynamically building a knowledge graph that reflects inherent data structures and connections.CKGC leverages text chunking, large language models (LLMs), and ontology mapping. By segmenting text and using LLMs to identify key entities and relationships, CKGC constructs a contextualized knowledge graph enriching information representation. This bridges the gap between semantic similarity and deeper contextual understanding, enabling more accurate and nuanced retrieval.Experiments on 2,000 lease agreements demonstrate that CKGC significantly improves vector-based RAG in information retrieval and question answering tasks, with substantial gains in Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) and Top-k Accuracy. CKGC’s adaptability across domains positions it as a valuable tool for enhancing performance and understanding of complex textual data. Our findings underscore CKGC’s transformative potential in unlocking insights from vast text corpora, paving the way for more intelligent and context-aware information retrieval systems.

articleTitle: Condition Monitoring and Fault Diagnosis of BLDC Motor in Electric Vehicles Using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Due to their high benefits in terms of environment and standards of battery advancement, Electric Vehicles (EVs) are extremely important in the shift towards transportation. Here the Brushless DC (BLDC) motor is an integrated part of the EVs, and it has become the most popular choice due to better efficiency, reliability, and reduced maintenance requirements than the others. The major difference from traditional motors is that BLDC motors make use of electronic commutation, so brushes are not employed; this results in lower amounts of wear. This not only helps the motor to have a longer working life but also to work more efficiently, or to maintain their efficiency. However, one crucial drawback to using BLDC motors is the fact that they tend to perform and have great durability if the condition monitoring and fault diagnosis systems when utilized top-notch. These systems are important for the identification of abnormalities and possible defects that if not attended to can lead to major failures and long periods of non-productive time. The ability to track the state of BLDC motors in real time enables one to have preventive measures that cut the chances of the motor breaking down and consequently the costs attached to this eventuality. Condition monitoring involves continuous assessment of motor attributes such as; vibration, temperature, and electrical patterns in a bid to detect changes in healthy motor status. Whereas the existing literature on the level of faults goes beyond it by identifying the specific nature and location of the faults. Altogether, the procedures composed play the basic role of a predictive maintenance program and check BLDC motors’ performance and reliability throughout their usage. Given the importance of BLDC motors in EVs, improvements in the reliability of condition monitoring and fault diagnosis are unpreventable for the enhancement and sustainability of electric mobility.

articleTitle: EMG Signal Processing for Disease Classification using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Electromyography (EMG) plays a crucial role in the medical sector for assessing muscular health and diagnosing related ailments. With a growing global demand for EMG equipment and its surpassing significance over other diagnostic tools, EMG has become instrumental in addressing muscle disorders and designing prosthetic limbs. EMG captures electrical impulses generated during muscle activities, finding applications in medical, biological, and human-computer interface realms. Recent studies have delved deep into refining EMG signal processing through various machine learning algorithms, such as neural networks and support vector machines. This paper comprehensively reviews methodologies that include supervised learning, unsupervised learning, data preprocessing, feature extraction, classification algorithms such as real-time classification, and performance evaluation. The synthesis of cutting-edge techniques from interdisciplinary sectors promises a brighter future for EMG-based applications, particularly in assistive technologies. The writer has made effort for understanding better categorization of EMG signals for more significant research.

articleTitle: Analyzing Byte Level Tokenization for two Layer Encryption Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Since Cloud Computing uses open environments to store data and distribute resources, security has emerged as the primary barrier impeding the development of Cloud environments. Despite the efficiency and promise of cloud computing, there are numerous data security issues because cloud users do not have physical access to their data. We examined a technique that uses the RSA algorithm to guarantee data security. Following the implementation of Byte Tokenization, it is encrypted using the RSA and AES algorithms once more. We have also examined the algorithm's performance in terms of three parameters are Time Complexity, Space Complexity, and Throughput. The study critically analyzes existing encryption methodologies, highlights their limitations, and introduces a novel hybrid algorithm designed to improve both security and performance.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review of Supervised Learning Algorithms in Healthcare Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Supervised learning has revolutionized the concept of personalization in treatment with the development of Precision Medicine. This review aims to provide a systematic analysis of the utilization of supervised learning in healthcare and its functions in diagnostics and prognoses, recommendations for treatment, and patient surveillance. Classification algorithms such as Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machines, and Decision Trees. Regression techniques such as Linear Regression, Polynomial Regression, and Neural Networks. Ensemble methods such as Bagging, Boosting, and Stacking. Deep learning techniques such as Convolutional Neural Networks, Recurrent Neural Networks, and Long Short-Term Memory are discussed for their efficiency and applicability in various healthcare applications. There are strengths highlighted by the review including enhanced diagnostic capabilities and patient-targeted therapy alongside weaknesses such as quality of data, interpretability as well as compatibility with existing healthcare systems. This review gives a more generalized approach to how supervised learning algorithms help to enhance healthcare results and identifies the likely topic that requires more research in the future.

articleTitle: Predictive Analytics in Performance Appraisal Systems: Enhancing Objectivity and Fairness
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Background & Scope: Performance evaluation systems are crucial in evaluating employee performance, providing feedback, and facilitating talent development initiatives. Conventional performance evaluation systems rely on personal opinions and are susceptible to prejudice. Utilizing data-driven predictive analytics enhances the objectivity and equity of the performance evaluation system. This study examines the potential role of predictive analytics in improving the fairness and impartiality of performance rating systems. The study investigates the potential of predictive analytics models to mitigate biases, improve accuracy, and promote objectivity in performance evaluation.Methodology: A detailed and comprehensive analysis of the literature on predictive analytics in performance management and staff development has been done to identify gaps and find untapped areas. The research integrates the data from organizations that employ predictive analytics for their employee performance evaluations, which have been included as a sample in this research for the Qualitative assessment & review.Originality: This research contributes to the current understanding of the application of predictive analytics in the organization's employee performance assessment system. It provides an in-depth analysis of the advantages, disadvantages, and methods of using predictive analytics in assessing human resource management operations for an employee's performance.Implications and Future Directions: Performance assessment systems that utilize and implement predictive analytics in the organization to improve the fairness, accuracy, and impartiality of HRM decision-making and that can examine the ethical, scalability, and long-term impacts of using and applying predictive analytics in the Organization for Performance assessment in the HRM practices.

articleTitle: Augmented Reality Enhanced Clinical Training: Implications for Skill Acquisition and Retention in Medical Education
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: This paper delves into the integration of Augmented Reality (AR) in medical education, reviewing current literature and contrasting traditional learning methods with AR-enhanced approaches. It examines the development and effectiveness of AR-based applications in medical training, focusing on the impacts on skill acquisition, knowledge retention, and practical competency. By analyzing studies, the paper reveals the measurable improvements AR brings to learning outcomes, including enhanced comprehension and engagement. Student surveys further illuminate the value of AR, capturing learners' preferences, challenges, and the perceived benefits in simulated environments. The findings underscore AR's transformative potential in medical education, positioning it as a tool to prepare future healthcare professionals with immersive and hands-on experiences.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on Challenges and Solutions on Product Classification Based on Data Virtualization
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: In the digital world product classification is one of the critical success factors of organizations who increasingly have to handle large amount of data, enhance customers’ experience and optimize organizational workflows. There are several issues that can be considered as a problem for efficient classification: The data associated with the products are rather complex and the markets are constantly in the state of change. This paper aims at undertaking a comparative analysis of the obstacles in product classification and include the methods and technologies that have been used to execute issues like data inconsistencies, high-dimensional data, and dynamic attributes among others. Furthermore, the research focuses on the effects of data integration and real time processing on product classification and consequently explores by how much the diffusion of these factors relates to classification outcome. As a result of this comparative study, the research establishes the effective strategies of handling some of the challenges which are faced by organization while implementing and maintaining classification system like large volume of data, unstructured data and need to adapt the classification systems to the market needs. Python software is used to enhance the approach. The integration of K-Means clustering strengthen the classification by grouping products based on features like price and ratings. The Multi-Layer Perceptron-Gated Recurrent Unit (MLP-GRU) hybrid model effectively classified products into categories such as 'Premium Electronics' and 'Trendy Fashion Items' by leveraging feature extraction and sequence modeling on pre-clustered data, demonstrating superior accuracy and reliability. With 99% accuracy, the suggested Hybrid Multi-Layer Perceptron-Gated Recurrent Unit method outperforms Fully Connected Neural Network, Support Vector Machine, and Logistic Regression by 3.39%. This paper also features real-world cases showing how companies have successfully instituted product classification systems and the techniques that have been adopted to enhance the systems’ precision.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Human Behavioural for Analysing Actions in Sport Videos using Artificial Intelligence and Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Human behavior research is becoming more and more important in human-centered software. Today, many public spaces utilize video monitoring because of improvements in technology and decreased costs. However, the majority of surveillance systems on the market today are limited to identifying odd behavior and gathering data in the form of stored films. Therefore, to reduce workloads and increase productivity, improving methods for recognizing human behavior is critical. Recent advancements in computer vision and sports video analysis have produced notable gains that make several vital functions possible. To offer more sophisticated data—including intricate, thorough analyses in sports like badminton, cricket, basketball, and soccer—research has mostly concentrated on computer vision algorithms utilized to do various jobs. Identifying specific players and teams, as well as their actions and behaviors, throughout practices, competitions, and other events is known as human behavioral recognition, or HBR. In an unidentified video sequence, HBR seeks to determine the sort of action, its length, and the individual doing it. Performance monitoring is the main objective of HBR in sports, and it might involve a variety of tasks such as recognizing the player, tracking their every move, comparing the activities they've just completed, or automatically analyzing the outcomes of those comparisons. This paper provides an extensive overview of human behavioral comprehension for computer vision and artificial intelligence-based action analysis in sports videos. This paper also explores published works in a range of sports-related application-specific tasks and the opinions of current scholars on them.

articleTitle: Exploring Quantum Key Distribution
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: This paper explores the field of quantum key distribution (QKD) through the simulation of the BB84 protocol, a foundational breakthrough in secure communication. As quantum computing advances, traditional encryption schemes become increasingly vulnerable, highlighting the urgent need for quantum-resilient cryptographic methods. The BB84 protocol leverages quantum mechanics to enable secure key exchange between parties, with built-in mechanisms to detect eavesdropping. By employing the SimulaQron framework and CQC libraries, this research simulates the BB84 protocol in a peer-to-peer setting, showcasing its effectiveness in generating secure encryption keys and ensuring private communication. Additionally, this work provides valuable insights into programming within the quantum paradigm and establishes a platform for future developments in quantum cryptography.

articleTitle: Transforming healthcare: A comprehensive review of AI applications in medical care
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence, or AI, is changing the face of medical care. This is a complete overview that discusses how AI is changing the face of healthcare, from the problems it is solving, to how it is being used, the ethical dilemmas it presents, and what the future has in store for it. The AI in healthcare is so important because it could make diagnoses better, and it will make clinical work flows a lot more efficient and it will just really improve patient outcomes. This review covers AI applications in diagnostics and therapy, electronic health records, drug discovery and development, and big data analytics. It also discusses the ethics of AI in medicine such as patient privacy and security, discriminating and fairness, and medical liability. It also delves into the upcoming role of AI in health care and how it will affect the delivery of health care, innovation and collaboration, regulatory structure, and sustainable health care. All in all, this article testifies to the great promise that AI holds for the medical field, making healthcare better, more accessible, and more affordable. And the future potential for growth is huge, because AI is going to change the face of healthcare, for doctors, patients, and policy makers.

articleTitle: The Role of AI in Circular Economy Supply Chains: A Comparative Analysis of Industry Practices
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: In recent years, there has been a lot of interest in how artificial intelligence (AI) and the circular economy can work together. Typically because businesses are trying to find better approaches to diminish their effect on the environment and make the most excellent utilize of their assets. This paper looks at how distinctive businesses utilize AI in circular economy supply lines and compares their strategies. By empowering individuals to reuse, reuse, and repurpose things all through their lifetime, the circular economy tries to partitioned financial development from asset utilize. AI innovations, like machine learning calculations, prescient analytics, and robotic process computerization, are exceptionally imperative for making these supply chains more proficient and long-lasting. This comparison consider brings together comes about from a few different industries to appear the foremost imperative employments, points of interest, and issues that come with putting AI into hone. AI is being utilized in fabricating, retail, and innovation to form items that are less demanding to reuse, mechanize the sorting and teardown forms, and anticipate the showcase for recuperated materials. AI-driven optimization models moreover permit choices to be made in genuine time, which makes strides commerce proficiency and decreases squander. Case ponders appear that AI-powered prescient upkeep and supply chain openness endeavors have driven to huge changes in how assets are utilized, costs going down, and clearing out less of an effect on the environment. But issues still exist, such as stresses about data protection, unfair algorithms, and require for solid foundation and aptitude advancement. This paper talks about these problems in terms of being able to replicate and scale them up in different business settings. In addition, the comparison shows new patterns and possible future paths for supply lines in the cycle economy that use AI.

articleTitle: Harnessing Predictive Analytics for Accurate Consumer Behaviour Forecasting: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: This Paper highlights the importance of predictive analytics in understanding consumer behaviour and making accurate forecasts. Predictive analytics is essential for forecasting changes in customer behaviour and preferences as purchasing patterns evolve. In order to ascertain patterns and approaches within this field, this analysis examines scholarly literature, industry reports, and case studies. Our findings illustrate the significance of predictive models in comprehending customer behaviour. Predictive analytics usage is driven by the capacity to handle large datasets, integrate diverse variables such as demographic data, economic indicators, and consumer sentiment, and employ advanced computational methods. These algorithms effectively forecast consumer product selection behaviour, aiding firms in improving their strategy. These findings have significant implications for marketers, retailers, and legislators. Predictive analytics enables improved inventory management, focused marketing strategies, and alignment of products with customer demand. Analyzing consumer behaviour trends can provide valuable insights for making corporate and policy decisions. Future research directions include the integration of real-time data analytics, enhancing model accuracy through machine learning, and investigating the impact of developing technologies on customer behaviour. Predictive analytics is essential for understanding and adapting to contemporary consumer behaviour. This report proposes potential areas for more investigation and advancement.

articleTitle: Innovative AgTech: A Predictive Machine Learning-Driven Precision Farming Solution for Enhancing Agricultural Productivity in Wardha
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Agricultural productivity is crucial for economic growth of a nation, especially for countries like India which is highly dependent on agriculture. This study addresses the need for cutting-edge technology to enhance crop productivity by proposing a Mobile/Web-based precision farming system. Leveraging Machine Learning (ML) algorithms, the proposed system recommends optimal crops based on several factors such as environmental parameters (Nitrogen (N), Phosphorus (P), Potassium (K)), pH value, Temperature, Rainfall, Humidity and Soil Nutrients., The current study applied five ML algorithms Naïve Bayes, Random Forest, on a dataset comprising of 2200 records and 7 variables to create a predictive ML model. Among the five algorithms, the Naïve Bayes exhibits superior performance, achieving a precision rate of 99.50%. Despite challenges like data scarcity and the need for field validation, the research aims to provide Wardha farmers with a free and open-source precision farming platform. By facilitating informed crop management decisions, the platform seeks to augment agricultural productivity and foster sustainable economic growth in the region. The robustness of the proposed system is further validated by the identified algorithmic accuracy, with Random Forest emerging as the most efficient option for crop recommendation within the specified environmental context. This study under-scores the potential of precision farming to revolutionize agriculture and contribute to long-term economic development in emerging regions. The validation process involves a train-test split, cross-validation, and field validation to ensure the reliability and accuracy of the machine learning models. Additionally, the impact assessment highlights potential benefits such as improved crop yields, resource optimization, sustainable economic growth, and long-term environmental benefits for the Wardha region.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Automated Detection and Classification of B-cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: This study uses cutting-edge deep learning approaches to accurately classify peripheral blood smear (PBS) images of acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL). We present a convolutional neural network (CNN) model that uses the Blood Cells Cancer (ALL) dataset, which includes of 3242 PBS images from 89 patients, based on the EfficientNetB0 architecture. The program aims to distinguish between cases of benign and malignant leukemia, including specific subtypes, by processing and analyzing high-resolution blood smear images. Our approach involves a thorough data preparation process that includes image scaling, normalization, and augmentation. The CNN model achieved an impressive 99.54% test accuracy, demonstrating its effectiveness in correctly identifying leukemia. The findings demonstrate how deep learning models may increase the accuracy of leukemia diagnoses, which is crucial for timely and effective patient care.

articleTitle: Advantage of Using AI In Education to Enhance Learning: Review and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The increasing use of educational technologies has sparked intense research into their potential to transform teaching and learning experiences. Artificial Intelligence (AI) has emerged as a leader in this area, offering a wide range of tools to personalise learning, provide intelligent feedback, and adapt to individual student needs. This review paper aims to fill a crucial knowledge gap by thoroughly analysing current research on AI tools in education. We examined 51 research articles to investigate how researchers have assessed AI tools’ benefits for educators and students. Our analysis revealed recurring and emerging themes, creating a roadmap that sheds light on AI’s educational advancements while highlighting the main challenges that need to be addressed for successful implementation. Understanding the impact of AI tools on educators and students is essential at this critical juncture. By recognising both the advantages and challenges associated with AI in education, we can shape the development of pedagogically sound, ethically responsible tools. This review aims to provide educators with insights for integrating AI tools into their teaching methods, resulting in more personalised learning experiences, improved student engagement, and enhanced learning outcomes. It also emphasises addressing ethical concerns to ensure responsible and fair AI practices in education.

articleTitle: Healthcare Data Security and Privacy
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Precision health utilizes data from multiple sources, such as social media, health information, insurance claims, economics, and lifestyle, to provide tailored care, early detection and prediction of disease, and targeted treatments. It makes extensive use of computations (like machine learning), communication (like the interaction between the health data centres), and sensing technologies (like electronic health monitoring devices). Care must always be taken because sensitive personal information can be found in health data, such as the patient's name, the identity of the caregiver, and the patient's health issues. The revelation of these personal details can have a variety of negative effects on a person's life, such as harassment, increased insurance costs, and losing one's work because of a medical history. Consequently, the confidentiality, security, and reliability of the information are essential. Furthermore, ethics committees and government laws require that medical data be secure and private. Furthermore, the public, which is the source of the data, constantly demands the security, privacy, and confidence of their information. If not, they are able to refrain from providing their data to the precision health system. Consequently, precision health becomes less effective since the general public is the system's intended beneficiary.

articleTitle: The Future of Drug Discovery and Development: How Quantum Computing is Altering Pharmaceutical Research
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: This study investigates the usage of Digital Rx Quantum Computing in the pharmaceutical industry. The article discusses the importance of computational physics in accelerating drug discovery in its early degrees and decreasing expenses inside the pharmaceutical enterprise. It highlights the role of computational techniques, which includes system gaining knowledge of and molecular modeling, in preclinical investigations and the discovery of novel drug candidates. The article additionally emphasizes the contribution of click on chemistry and computational methods in developing drug formulations with progressed balance and improved drug transport. Additionally, it discusses the importance of reproducibility in computational drug discovery and the importance of facts sharing and collaboration. The article in addition explores key principles and techniques in Pharma's Digital Rx Quantum Computing, together with molecular modeling and simulation methods, molecular dynamics simulations, and quantum mechanics calculations. It concludes by way of discussing the position of protein structure prediction and analysis in drug discovery and the demanding situations on this field. Overall, this review article gives valuable insights into the application of Pharma's Digital Rx Quantum Computing in pharmaceutical studies and development.

articleTitle: Impact of Covid-19 on Survivor’s Health Using Machine Learning Techniques: Review
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The clever Crown illness (Coronavirus) has brought about medical services emergencies across the world. Additionally, the determined and delayed entanglements of post-coronavirus or long-term Coronavirus are likewise coming down on emergency clinic specialists because of the obliged medical services assets. Out of some durable post-coronavirus complexities, coronary illness has been acknowledged as the most widely recognized among Coronavirus survivors. Overcomers of Coronavirus are a weak populace, with complex requirements in light of waiting side effects and entanglements across different organ frameworks. Powerful wandering consideration for Coronavirus survivors requires coordination across numerous subspecialties, which can be difficult while possibly not all-around facilitated. With developing acknowledgment of these necessities, post-coronavirus centers are being made the nation over. Machine learning techniques are now being used to analyze and predict the impact, helping to uncover pattern, improve diagnostics capabilities and offer insights for managing post COVID health conditions. In this study, we analyzed various strategies of machine inclining for tracking down post-Coronavirus impact on survivors' well-being.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-based Secure Data Communication Framework For Autonomous Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Autonomous Electric Vehicles (AEVs), being an innovation in the transportation sector, are powered by electricity and technology to operate independently. However, to achieve self-driven abilities, AEVs depend on wireless communication networks and software systems, which increase susceptibility to cyber-attacks. Notably, such vulnerability can undermine passenger safety and the entire transportation network. This research examines Logistic Regression and Decision Tree classification Machine Learning (ML) techniques, focusing on enhancing AEV security against cyber threats. As part of the research, the following cyber attack scenarios were considered, and the effectiveness of ML techniques in real-time threat detection was reviewed. This study aims to develop stringent intrusion detection systems to protect AEVs in a practical scenario. Moreover, a system model and a problem formulation are provided to address cybersecurity challenges in AEVs. Through features like duration, protocol type, service, and others, this research apply the Gini index and gain ratio approaches for feature selection. Utilizing supervised ML algorithms, this research forecasts threatening actions and evaluates how acutely and swiftly they can be identified. The results of our research add to the general idea of cybersecurity in AEVs development processes. Continuous learning and monitoring are crucial in the context of unpredictable surroundings.

articleTitle: Handwritten Signature Verification using CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: A signature is a special kind of a sign made or given by a person on an instrument or document to indicate that he or she fully understands everything written on the document, agrees with them or being bound to fulfill the obligations stated on the document. It is used to verify the genuineness of the writing, to indicate origin and to constrain the signer to the provisions thus provided in the writing. Thus, the field of signature verification is not only valuable for the sphere of commercial banking, used for tools against frauds and approval of transactions, but also for a lot of other fields. Employment of this method is widely seen in legal, financial and governmental sectors to avoid forgery of numerous contracts agreements, legal instruments and other related documents. This paper concentrates on the offline handwritten signature verification using CNN, an advanced deep learning architecture which is famous for its capability to work on image data. CNNs are more appropriate for this task concerning the following characteristics: they are capable to draw out significant features from the province of the images of signatures, and the features like the strokes, texture, and general structure of signatures and so on with the high classification accuracy of genuine and forged signatures. This approach makes the signature verification more efficient and accurate and provides a better and automated solution for many applications for which signature authentication is most essential.

articleTitle: Developing an Intelligent Integrated Software Agent for Streamlined Interview Automation and Enhanced Candidate Insights
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: As the field of Conversational AI is advancing rapidly, introducing automated intelligent software agents in human interactions can exhibit human-like communicative be-haviors facilitating in more natural and engaging interactions with humans. These advancements provide opportunities to automate the candidate interview process by replacing human interviewers with intelligent autonomous software agents. Using Conversational AI, agents can ask questions, understand and evaluate response and initiate dynamic conversations closely resembling human interviewers. This automation enhances the efficiency of the overall interview process and ensures consistent and unbiased evaluation leading to more effective and fair hiring practices. This research paper aims to present a comprehensive study on the development and implementation of an AI-driven interview system designed to conduct candidate evaluations in real-time. The system integrates multiple AI agents, each performing different roles such as selecting predefined questions, evaluating candidate response, analyzing speech to assess emotions and sentiments, and synthesizing these analysis to provide separate scores for answers and emotions in the performance assessment.

articleTitle: Optimization Strategies for Cyber Threat Detection in Cloud Architectures Leveraging Deep Machine Learning for Advanced Malware Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The fast growth of cloud designs has created new security holes, which makes finding cyber threats a very important issue. This study looks into improvement methods that are meant to make it easier to find cyber threats in cloud settings. Using deep machine learning methods, the study aims to make it easier to spot advanced malware, which is very dangerous for cloud infrastructure. The recommended strategy combines optimization strategies with profound learning models to move forward the speed and precision of recognizable proof. The strategy incorporates looking at huge sets of information from cloud frameworks to educate models that can discover complex malware patterns. To discover out how well the moved forward discovery framework works, execution measures just like the rate of location, the rate of untrue positives, and the taken a toll of computing are looked at. The study comes about appear that profound machine learning is much superior at finding malware than standard strategies. This appears that profound machine learning has the capacity to create cloud security more grounded. This consider makes a difference make solid, versatile ways to discover cyber dangers in cloud frameworks. It gives us useful information for making security way better in a world that's becoming increasingly advanced.

articleTitle: Review of Machine Learning and Deep Learning algorithms for Personality traits classification
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Nowadays, people deal with major psychological issues on a daily basis, often in the absence of a desired support system. In the field of psychology, focus is on the thoughts, feelings, behaviors, goals, and interests of individuals. The psychologist conventionally considers various types of personality traits, like the Big 5 personality traits, the Myers-Briggs Type Indicator (MBTI), the OCEAN Model (Openness, Conscientiousness, Agreeableness, Extraversion, Neuroticism), and other methods also considered for measuring personality. To forecast personality traits like extraversion, agreeableness, openness, conscientiousness, and neuroticism, consider the name "Big Five personality traits" It is a universal model to forecast these personality traits. Studies on personality prediction that identify personality disorders from user content on social media sites like Facebook, Twitter, and WhatsApp primarily rely on user behavior on these platforms. A number of popular Deep Learning (DL) techniques have advanced recently, including Deep Belief Networks (DBNs), Convolution Neural Networks (CNNs), and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs). Examine these methods in terms of single and multiple modalities, including psychological, audio, video, text, and image information. Researchers currently focus on predicting personality traits using single-modality text features, static facial images, audio, and video clips, including interview recordings and YouTube videos. Therefore, the current study highlights that personality prediction mostly relies on written text, audio and video datasets used in Machine Learning (ML) and DL models. Additional investigation is needed to resolve ethical concerns and justify the use of psychological datasets and DL models to evaluate personality traits. By combining personality traits with a psychological dataset, this study imagines a time when people everyday struggles can be effectively addressed. The integration of ML and DL in the development of personality prediction models with validation represents a revolutionary step for the industry because they effectively classify personality traits.

articleTitle: Smart Finance: An overview of Artificial Intelligence Integration in Fintech
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The role of FinTech in advancing contemporary economies, societies, and technologies is growing. Smart FinTech is the next wave of FinTech that leverages artificial intelligence and data science methodologies to drive major advancements in fields including blockchain, cryptocurrencies, InsurTech, PayTech, BankingTech, TradeTech, LendTech, InsurTech, WealthTech, and RiskTech. An overview of these domains, as well as the artificial intelligence and data science techniques applied, is given in this paper. These techniques include augmentation, optimization, privacy-preserving processing, deep learning, federated learning, and intelligent interactions, complex system methods, mathematical approaches, knowledgeable communication, recognition and responses, and data analytics. This study offers a thorough analysis of smart financial companies, the obstacles they face, the smart FinTech environment, the artificial intelligence and data science methods that make smart FinTech possible, and potential future research areas for the artificial intelligence and data science community. To improve comprehension and analysis, the work makes use of visual aids such as figures and tables. The relevance of data quality, including data augmentation and manipulation, as well as enhancing fairness and decision-support, is emphasized in the study for financial firms. It also covers ethical and explicable FinTech, with a focus on privacy preservation, accountability, openness, and objectivity in FinTech and business designs. The potential for more research and innovation at the heart of analytics, data science, and FinTech is highlighted in the paper's conclusion.

articleTitle: Temperature Monitoring System using Drone for Agriculture Sector
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Temperature Monitoring in Agriculture by Drones, as its name implies, deals with temperature monitoring in agriculture using drones. Growing plants requires control of temperatures and understanding the principles of this control helps in achieving the maximum possible out of the crops and also reducing losses. Right from the start, it would be beneficial to learn the basics of monitoring temperature with the help of drones for temperature control strategies to be effectively formulated and implemented for agricultural crops. 5Understanding the Importance of Temperature Control for Crop Health is an important area in agriculture. Temperature fluctuations can have great impact on the health and productivity of the crops. This paper discusses various issues associated with temperature control in agriculture and argues for the effective and reliable temperature monitoring. With the understanding of the importance of temperature control, it will be easy for you to adopt practices that promote crop health and therefore increase the harvest. Drones for Temperature Monitoring and Notification with Extreme Advances in Technology is a nurse field that goes beyond the basic uses of drones in agriculture: temperature monitoring and notification systems. Drones allow the monitoring of temperature conditions incredibly easy and provide the farmer with most reliable information within the shortest period. The significance of maintaining an optimal temperature for crops is discussed in the paper. In addition, the paper discusses the application of drone technology in real time temperature monitoring and temperature notification. Appropriate action can be taken with the help of advanced technology such as drone by the farmers when there are temperature variations. Management of agricultural temperatures using drones is a skill that students of this course will acquire and be able to put into practice.

articleTitle: Beyond the Hype: A Critical Evaluation of Predictive Analytics Accuracy in High-Stakes Business Decisions
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The dawning digital era has brought expectations of massive improvements in the accuracy and value of corporate decision-making relating to strategic direction, business execution, performance management, and workforce management. With the advent of analytics, people-related and other data from disparate systems within a company are being used to predict important organizational outcomes or events such as customer satisfaction, future workforce attrition, expense overruns, project completion problems, etc. This predictive process is typically referred to as advanced, predictive, or prescriptive analytics. In this study, we take a critical look at the current organizational practice of predictive analytics using employee data residing in organizational HR systems. Focusing on high-stakes business outcomes, we consider the data and use of predictive models, and we review what HR professionals are telling their CEOs. We also look to ensure that the self-reported accuracy ratings are realistic and that the business benefits derived from these predictions or recommendations are indeed realized. Addressing this question across six large corporations in India using more than 10 regularly used applications, the results of this study are based on data from 816 HR professionals and 333 business leaders. All use predictive scores from related applications or in their decision-making roles. We find that there are a number of serious model accuracy problems with the applications used. We also find that both HR professionals and business leaders in India suffer from significant accuracy overestimation.

articleTitle: Hydro-Sense: Precision Agriculture and Water Conservation
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Inefficient water management practices in agriculture result in the wastage of water and have adverse effects on crop yield. To address this issue, we present "Hydro-Sense," a precision agriculture approach that aims to supply crops with water only when needed, thus conserving water resources, and enhancing crop Our work focuses on creating a hardware and software system that determines a crop's water needs based on its unique characteristics, its immediate surroundings, and the quantity of water stored. We have developed two main formulas: one that classifies the water at hand according to plant urgency, and another that assesses the plants' need for water based on a variety of parameters, like soil moisture, plant species, and atmospheric conditions. The hardware prototype of Hydro-Sense includes sensors to collect relevant data, a calculation module to determine water requirements, and a distribution mechanism to supply water to plants as needed. The software component integrates these calculations and data collection, providing real-time information to farmers through a user-friendly GUI frontend displayed on an app. Our findings demonstrate the effectiveness of Hydro-Sense in conserving water while ensuring optimal plant growth. Agriculture is made more sustainable and effective by Hydro-Sense, which optimizes crop output while conserving water by regulating the supply of water based on plant requirements.

articleTitle: HR Nexus: A Comprehensive Solution for Organized Workforce Management
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Our project "HR Nexus", is a comprehensive Human Resource Management system designed for efficient workforce organization in projects. It automates processes like on boarding, attendance tracking, leave management, and performance evaluation to boost productivity and foster a harmonious project environment. The user-friendly interface ensures accessibility for administrators and employees alike. Centralized data management supports accurate decision making and contributes to overall project success. Going beyond traditional HR functions, "HR Nexus" introduces innovative tools for improved communication and collaboration among team members. With a focus on scalability, the system is tailored to project-specific requirements, optimizing human resource processes, and minimizing administrative overhead. By implementing the "HR Nexus," organizations can showcase the importance of effective HR management in various projects, offering a practical solution to enhance overall organizational efficiency. In summary, the "HR Nexus" is a versatile system that streamlines HR processes, encourages collaboration, and emphasizes adaptability in project-based environments, ultimately contributing to organizational success.

articleTitle: New Era of Healthcare: Utilizing Artificial Intelligence to Unlock Telehealth's Full Potential Post-Pandemic
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has accelerated the adoption of telehealth, creating a pivotal moment for the future of healthcare. By addressing these issues and leveraging AI's capabilities, we can utilize telehealth's full potential, creating a more strong, equitable, and patient-centric diagnostic accuracy, personalize treatment plans, and enable predictive analytics, transforming telehealth into a more effective and efficient care delivery system. Additionally, AI-powered virtual health assistants and wearable devices offer continuous monitoring and support. Despite challenges such as data privacy, technology access, and regulatory hurdles, the potential for AI in telehealth is vast. In conclusion, the article emphasizes the importance of evidence-based research, standardized guidelines, and collaborative efforts to optimize telehealth interventions and overcome barriers, ultimately enhancing healthcare delivery and access in the digital age.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review of Personalized Learning Platforms and Their Impact on Student Performance in AI Education
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: This abstract discusses the emergence of Artificial Intelligence-powered personalized learning platforms in education and their profound impact. It highlights various platform types and their AI-driven content customization for individual learners. These platforms are noted for improving student engagement, learning outcomes, and retention, creating a learner-centered environment. However, challenges related to data privacy, algorithmic biases, and content creation is acknowledged, emphasizing the need for ethical AI use and ongoing evaluation for lasting effectiveness in education.

articleTitle: 5G Wireless Communication and IoT: Vision, Applications, and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: This article looks at the opportunities, application and challenges of 5G Wireless Communication Technologies and Internet of Things (IoT). A brief history from 1G to 5G is presented and the limitations of 4G and the introduction of 5G as a solution for problems with latency and speed. The paper also describes the 5G IoT concept, the architecture and advanced technologies with focus on different IoT applications such as smart agriculture and smart city. When speaking of aspects such as energy consumption, privacy and security concerns, as well as trade-offs strategies, it underlines how important collaboration is to achieve the benefits that the 5G IoT will bring. The paper itself provides a roadmap for next studies with a purpose of advancing development of the integrated, safe, and efficient wireless. As 5G Wireless Communication and IoT progresses the expectation is that it will enhance and revolutionalize several domains that will offer a scalable connectivity that is faster and more reliable. This join venture is believed to open new value adding opportunities for application in smart city, automobile, medical, industrial, robotic and so on several other fields. The term 5G IoT has also been used with the intention of establishing connections of several devices, very low latency and high degree of data rate for real time analysis and decision making.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review of Bio-Medical Portable Devices for Blood Coagulation Detection Device
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The paper provides a synoptic view of portable biomedical point-of-care devices for blood coagulation detection, emphasising the state-of-the-art technology adopted and its use in the medical industry. These devices give fast and precise results at the point of care and are indispensable for diagnosing coagulation and perceiving thrombotic states. It brought into focus the issues of monitoring blood coagulation across different areas of practice, such as the ICU, operative and perioperative services, and ambulatory care. This paper also highlights new trends in the development of sensors, miniaturisation and the integration of digital health solutions. Further, it explains how these devices are advantageous and disadvantageous in terms of speed, sample requirement, standardisation, calibration, and user-friendliness. Last but not least, the regulation and market uptake issue is discussed, focusing on how portable coagulation detection devices can revolutionise patient care and access to healthcare. Finally, the authors state that the paper should inspire further research to develop new solutions and collaboration to address obstacles and underpin advancements in the field.

articleTitle: Interactive Coding Platform with Code Summarizer
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: This study presents a Code Summarizer cum Explanation Tool which helps as the student specially those who are beginner in the world of coding to understand other’s solution for a given problem statement. Our approach involves the utilization of this state-of- the-art language model, widely acknowledged for its prowess in handling various text- related tasks such as code generation and summarization. In this study we have use an open-sourced state-of-the art large language model which is used for many downstream text related task such as code generation, code summarisation, etc. and consist of 7 Billion parameters (weights & biases) developed by Technology Innovation Institute (TIIUAE). We fine-tuned the said model on our custom dataset for code explanation task. We have fine-tuned the model for 1 epoch which took approximate 3 hours on 590 steps. As a result we have obtained a brief summary, when given code as a prompt input. By bridging the gap between theoretical understanding and practical application, our Code Summarizer/Explanation Tool can become an useful tool for beginners on their coding journey.

articleTitle: AI in Healthcare: An International Quest for Criminal Liability in Medical Negligence Cases
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The advanced technology of ‘AI’ seemingly has made human life much easier in this twenty-first century in different aspects of life. Healthcare service is also an area that gets a positive impact from AI as it helps to diagnose diseases and develop procedures to treat them, as well as the outcomes that will be helpful in curing the diseases. However, the advancement in technology in this area of the doctor-patient relationship raises another contentious legal issue of who is legally responsible for medical negligence as the technology is also getting in between. The health and safety of the patient must be the paramount consideration before employing AI for any medical purpose. As patient repose his/her trust to the medical professional with a belief that such procedure would result into their better health. Considering the trust of the patient, consumer and service provider agreement, the legal liability is required to minimize the medial negligence and awakening the medical professionals. publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
