articleTitle: AI in Sustainable Construction: Techniques, Impacts and Solutions
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) application in sustainable construction is a revolutionary way to improve construction methods and practices, minimize the negative effects on the environment, and manage the resources efficiently. This review presents the responsibilities, advantages and uses of AI in green construction. Based on such technologies as predictive modeling, the design of smart buildings, and efficient management systems of construction projects, the construction sector can decrease CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions and advance environmental sustainability. In addition, the paper also examines barriers to the applications of AI such as technology constraints, high cost of deployment, and inadequate talent. In conclusion, this paper also discusses how AI has impacted sustainable construction and its implications and further direction for encouraging its application in the construction industry.

articleTitle: ML-based IoT Communication Data Analysis Framework for Energy Crisis Management in Commercial Buildings
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Modern society depends substantially on the consumption of energy, which impacts both environmental sustainability and economic stability. This study analyzes the efficient management of energy use across several zones, with a focus on commercial applications, which account for a considerable amount of worldwide energy consumption. It emphasizes the significance of telecommunications to maintain surveillance on and optimize energy use, utilizing cutting-edge technology like 5G and IoT to send data in real-time and mitigate crises. The proposed system model incorporates multi-sensors to monitor environmental factors such as humidity and temperature, paired with secure data transmission methods to prevent unauthorized access. The findings reveal a significant increase in power consumption from 2018 to 2019, and timely analysis facilitated by telecommunications can substantially assuage the crisis. This research underscores the importance of integrating telecommunication technologies with energy management systems to ensure reliable, efficient, and secure energy usage, thus addressing one of the most pressing challenges in today’s energydependent world.

articleTitle: Integrating Artificial Intelligence in Early Childhood Education: A Review of Current Practices and Future Directions
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Background-With the rapid technological development in the world with Artificial intelligence in Early childhood education (AIED) and development is a new focus in digital literacy education research. Despite its expanding importance, AI literacy is mostly unexplored in early childhood education (ECE), as AI courses for young children have only recently emerged. It is vital to establish AI competencies in the next generation and educate them on properly engaging with numerous toolkits and curricula to enable young children to learn about AI by creating, programming, training, interacting, and using AI. Methods-Previous studies on AI in education have primarily focused on curriculum design for kindergarten, secondary, and university levels and toolkits like social robots, addressing challenges and opportunities. However, research on AI in early childhood education (ECE) remains limited. This study evaluates various research designs, pedagogical approaches, and interventions, exploring how different AI tools help young children to know how to foster AI literacy in terms of concepts, practices, and perspectives. Results-The selected articles published from the year 2019 to 2024 which studied AI in Education and Development, Current research, technology, and applications in AI education have shown that activity-based learning is more effective than other modes of learning and has potential educational benefits. This study also looked at how well children comprehended AI ideas according to their age and gender, in addition to their direct involvement with social robots and AI courses. Conclusion-It highlights the potential and importance of AI literacy in ECE, that young children can quickly grasp AI concepts through interactive activities with a social robot, suggesting that hands-on exploration effectively enhances AI literacy. Future research should focus on expanding the curriculum to include more comprehensive materials and adapting it for diverse educational contexts.

articleTitle: The Transformative Impact of Telehealth on Chronic Disease Management: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Telehealth has made a great impact on the chronic disease management with new strategies to better treat patients and improve patient health. In this detailed review, the use of telehealth technologies is studied as a means to control chronic illnesses like diabetes and hypertension. In this paper, we examine some of the latest research that demonstrates the power of telehealth interventions in enhancing patient compliance, self-management, and access to healthcare services in a timelier fashion. Our findings reveal that telehealth not only enhances communication between patients and healthcare providers but also empowers individuals to take an active role in their health management. Studies show that telehealth can result in a very significant improvement in clinical outcome, lowering HbA1c in diabetics, better blood pressure control in hypertensives. We also delve into the monetary efficiency of telehealth when opposed to more conventional medical practices, and how it is possible that telehealth can decrease medical cost, yet still provide the same quality care. However, even with all of its advantages, there are still obstacles to telehealth implementation such as technological disparities and the digital literacy gap among patients. This just goes to show how these issues need to be addressed in order to give everyone fair access to telehealth especially those who have never gotten a fair shake. While telehealth is certainly not a new concept, its rapid growth in the past decade has shown the potential for its ability to revolutionize chronic disease management through a more patient-centered approach to healthcare delivery. This paper should be of interest to healthcare providers, legislators, and researchers as they consider the future of telehealth in the management of chronic disease.

articleTitle: Human Body Bone Fracture Identification using Improved Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Accidental human bone fractures require repair. Fractured bones include geometric information. The resolved body fractures show better conformance along the sensitive substrate, notably in the frontal face. Computer vision can repair and reconstruct bones. CAD tools assist diagnose and repair fractured bones. A difficult research topic is developing an autonomous and accurate human bone fracture detection CAD framework using bone scans. Deep Learning (DL) inspire us to propose the Automatic Detection of Human Bone Fractures (ADHBF) using input bone pictures. The ADHBF model includes pre-processing, bone segmentation, feature extraction, and classification. Pre-processing the bone picture with general filtering and contrast modification improves its quality. To accurately locate the ROI, the ADHBF framework segmented the bone using a dynamic threshold-based technique. ADHBF extracts bone features using the suggested CNN model. Using alternative activation functions with dropout layer, we improve CNN layers for classification. We adjusted the pre-trained model’s CNN layers to minimize training time and overfitting/underfitting. For human bone fracture prediction, the softmax classifier classifies automated CNN features. Experimental results utilizing the public dataset show the model’s efficiency. The ADHBF boosts anticipation accuracy by 3.56 % and processing efficiency by 6.27%.

articleTitle: ShieldSMS Sentinel: Guardian of Your Digital Communication Bastion
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The SMS spam detection Project provides a comprehensive framework for reliably identifying and classifying spam messages sent over SMS communication channels by fusing ML algorithms with NLP techniques. Using EDA, a dataset of labelled SMS messages identified as spam or ham is thoroughly studied to reveal patterns in the word count, sentence count, and message length distributions. Then, unstructured text is transformed into structured data that may be utilized with ML models through tokenization, punctuation and stop word removal, stemming, and other text preprocessing techniques. Feature engineering, which numerically represents text data using vectorization techniques like BoW and TF-IDF, plays a significant role. Various ML algorithms, including Gaussian Naive Bayes, Multinomial Naive Bayes, SVM, and ensemble approaches, are trained and evaluated. Performance metrics, including accuracy and precision, serve as standards for model selection.

articleTitle: Smart Hiring: Leveraging AI for Effective Employee Selection
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: AI is revolutionizing recruitment by increasing efficiency, reducing bias, and enhancing candidate experiences. It automates job postings, resume screening, talent evaluation, and onboarding. Through data mining, social media, and automatic responses, AI tools improve decision-making, efficiency, and diversity in hiring. Technologies like deep learning and natural language processing expedite resume screening, candidate evaluation, and interview scheduling. However, ethical considerations, such as privacy, transparency, and fairness, are crucial to address. AI also enhances employee development by personalizing training and enabling continuous learning through online courses and virtual classrooms. While AI brings significant advantages to HR and recruitment, balancing technical advancements with ethical principles is essential to mitigate issues like job displacement and data privacy. Organizations must ensure ethical AI usage to maximize benefits and minimize unintended consequences.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence in OSCE: Innovations and Implications for Medical Education Assessment – A Systematic Review
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Objective Structured Clinical Examinations (OSCEs) are cornerstone for evaluation of competencies pertaining to clinical medicine. The recent advent of artificial intelligence has given rise to newer opportunities which evidently have improved the reliability, validity, objectivity of OSCE. This draft deals into the concept of integration of artificial intelligence into OSCE with proper focus on technology technology innovations there in such as provision of real-time feedback and incorporation of virtual simulations as well. As per the PRISMA guidelines, we conducted a literature search and analysed studies available in literature from 2018 till 2024. We have concluded that artificial intelligence as a technological innovation in the world of assessment of clinical competencies. In medical education has a very strong potential to reduce examiner bias, provision of detailed feedback, and simulating realistic clinical scenarios. Still, certain challenges and limitation such as lack of emotional intelligence and the human touch to the entire assessment. Scenario seems to be lagging and is therefore much needed to retain the learning curve of the modern day learners.

articleTitle: A Review on Machine Learning Assisted Drying Behaviour Prediction of Agricultural Seeds and Fruits
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: Machine learning approaches have been more popular in recent years across many scientific and engineering fields, with the potential to improve drying behavior and thermal property predictions in terms of accuracy and efficiency. Agricultural seeds and fruits must be handled carefully after harvest because drying has a considerable impact on their quality, shelf life, and overall worth. To optimize drying processes and guarantee product quality, drying kinetics and thermal characteristics must be accurately predicted. This review article outlines the basic principles of drying, emphasizes their significance in determining the ideal drying conditions, and provides a thorough overview of the application of machine learning methods for predicting the drying kinetics and thermal properties of agricultural seeds and fruits. Then, in the context of their applications to drying prediction, a summary of several machine learning approaches, including artificial neural networks, support vector machines, and decision trees have been discussed.

articleTitle: Hybrid Machine Learning Models for Accurate Fake News Identification in Online Content
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The growing problem of fake news in online material has big effects on how people talk and trust each other. The use of hybrid machine learning models is a potential way to find and stop the spread of false information. This study looks at how combining several machine learning techniques can make finding fake news more accurate and reliable. Traditional algorithms like Support Vector Machines (SVM) and Decision Trees are combined with more modern ones like Neural Networks and Natural Language Processing (NLP) to create a full model that can understand both written and contextual information. The mixed model takes advantage of the best parts of each program, making up for the problems that some methods might have when used by themselves. A large set of different online news stories, including both real and fake ones, are used for a lot of experiments. The model is put through a lot of tests to see how well it does in a number of areas, such as accuracy, precision, memory, and F1 score. The results show that this method is much more accurate at finding fake news than single-way approaches, especially when it comes to finding the complex patterns of lying that are common in fake news. The mixed model works well in cross-domain uses, which shows that it can handle different kinds of online material. Issues like feature selection, model complexity, and computing speed are dealt with by using optimization methods. This makes sure that the mixed model can still be used in real time. The study stresses how important it is to combine different machine learning methods to make a more complete and useful system for finding fake news. Finding false information is a bigger topic, but this study adds to that discussion by creating a system that can be used on many platforms and languages. The results show that mixed models are very important for making automatic systems that find fake news more accurate and reliable.

articleTitle: Leveraging Artificial Intelligence for Efficient Road Traffic Management
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd DMIHER International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare, Education and Industry (IDICAIEI)
abstract: The computer-based intelligence contexts for traffic signals are made to help the street transport network by expanding effectiveness, wellbeing, and manageableness. Traffic frameworks use information examination, AI, and high- level calculations to expand the traffic stream, decrease blockage, and generally drive street welfare. Preprocessing techniques and ML models used in ASC, pattern recognition, and traffic prediction are all examined in this paper. Data collection methods and AI-based traffic management implementation strategies are also discussed. The difficulties of coordinating artificial intelligence advancements into the ongoing traffic frameworks are likewise covered, including worries about open routineness, foundation expenses, and information protection. Through an exhaustive examination, this study presents the likely advantages and future chances of man-made intelligence (computer-based intelligence) in street traffic across the board. Additionally, it highlights the significance of interoperability, scalability, and enhanced connectivity for upcoming technologies like 5G and the Internet of Things.
